text: Nhar it-Tnejn, xjentisti mill-Iskola tal-Mediċina tal-Università ta’ Stanford ħabbru l-invenzjoni ta’ għodda dijanjostika ġdida li tista’ tirranġa ċ-ċelloli skont it-tip: ċippa ċkejkna li tista’ tiġi stampata li tista’ tiġi manifatturata bl-użu ta’ inkjet printers standard għal possibilment madwar ċenteżmu tal-Istati Uniti kull waħda.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Riċerkaturi ewlenin jgħidu li dan jista’ jġib miegħu sejbien bikri ta’ kanċer, tuberkulożi, HIV u malarja lil pazjenti f’pajjiżi bi dħul baxx, fejn ir-rati ta’ sopravivenza għal mard bħall-kanċer tas-sider jistgħu jkunu nofs dawk ta’ pajjiżi aktar sinjuri.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: JAS 39C Gripen iġġarraf fuq runway bejn wieħed u ieħor madwar id-9.30 am ħin lokali (0230 UTC) u sploda, u minħabba f'hekk, għalaq l-ajruport għal titjiriet kummerċjali.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Il-pilota ġie identifikat bħala Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Il-midja lokali tirrapporta li vettura li titfi n-nar fl-ajruport inqalbet waqt li kienet qed tirrispondi.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, ta' 28 sena, kien ingħaqad ma' Barça tliet staġuni ilu, mingħand Sevilla.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Minn meta mar jgħix fil-belt kapitali Katalana, Vidal lagħab 49 logħba mal-klabb.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Il-protesta bdiet għal ħabta tal-11:00 ħin lokali (UTC+1) fuq Whitehall quddiem id-daħla mgħassa mill-pulizija għal Downing Street, ir-residenza uffiċjali tal-Prim Ministru.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Eżatt wara l-11:00, id-dimostranti mblukkaw it-traffiku fuq il-karreġġjata sejra lejn it-Tramuntana ġewwa Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Fil-11:20, il-pulizija talbu lid-dimostranti jerġgħu jitilgħu fuq il-bankina, u ddikjaraw li kellhom bżonn isibu bilanċ bejn id-dritt li jipprotestaw u t-traffiku li kien qed jakkumula.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Bejn wieħed u ieħor fil-11:29, il-protesta mxiet ’il fuq f’Whitehall, għaddiet minn Trafalgar Square, tul l-iStrand, għaddiet minn Aldwych u ’l fuq f’Kingsway lejn Holborn fejn il-Partit Konservattiv kien qed imexxi l-Forum tar-Rebbiegħa tiegħu fil-lukanda Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Ir-rekord ras imb’ras ta’ Nadal versu  l-Kanadiż huwa 7–2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Riċentement tilef kontra Raonic fil-Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal akkwista 88% tal-punti netti fil-logħba u rebaħ 76 punt fl-ewwel serve.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Wara l-logħba, ir-Re tat-Tafal qal, "Jien sempliċiment eċitat li ninsab lura fir-rawnds finali tal-aktar avvenimenti importanti. Jien qiegħed hawn biex nirbaħ."
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Panama Papers" huwa terminu ġenerali għal madwar għaxar miljun dokument mill-kumpanija legali Panamanjana Mossack Fonseca, li ġew mikxufa lill-istampa fir-rebbiegħa tal-2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Id-dokumenti wrew li erbatax-il bank għenu lill-klijenti sinjuri jaħbu biljuni ta’ dollari Amerikani ta’ ġid biex jevitaw taxxi u regolamenti oħra.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Il-gazzetta Ingliża “The Guardian” issuġġeriet li d-Deutsche Bank ikkontrolla bejn wieħed u ieħor terz tal-1200 kumpanija fittizja użati biex jagħmlu dan.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Kien hemm protesti madwar id-dinja, diversi prosekuzzjonijiet kriminali, u l-mexxejja tal-gvernijiet tal-Iżlanda u l-Pakistan it-tnejn irriżenjaw.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Imwieled f’Hong Kong, Ma studja fl-Università ta’ New York u l-Iskola tal-Liġi ta’ Harvard u darba kellu "green card" ta’ resident permanenti Amerikan.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh implika matul l-elezzjoni li Ma jista’ jaħrab mill-pajjiż fi żmien ta’ kriżi.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh argumenta wkoll li Ma fotogeniku kien aktar stil milli sustanza.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Minkejja dawn l-akkużi, Ma rebaħ b'kapaċità fuq pjattaforma li tappoġġja rabtiet iktar mill-qrib mal-kontinent Ċiniż.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Il-Plejer tal-Jum tal-lum huwa Alex Ovechkin li jilgħab mal-Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Huwa kellu 2 gowls u 2 assists fir-rebħa 5-3 ta’ Washington fuq l-Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: L-ewwel “assist” tal-lejla ta’ Ovechkin kienet fuq il-gowl rebbieħ tal-logħba mill-plejer il-ġdid Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Dan it-tieni gowl tiegħu ta’ dik il-lejla kien is-60 gowl tiegħu tal-istaġun, u sar l-ewwel plejer li skorja 60 gowl jew iktar fi staġun mill-1995-96, meta Jaromir Jagr u Mario Lemieux laħqu dak it-tragward it-tnejn li huma.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten ġie kklassifikat fil-190 post fuq il-lista tal-400 Amerikani l-Iktar Sinjuri tal-2008 b’fortuna stmata ta’ $2.3 biljun.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Huwa ggradwa mill-Kulleġġ tal-Arti u x-Xjenza tal-Università ta’ Virginia fl-1950 u kien donatur importanti għal dik l-istituzzjoni.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Il-ħabs Abu Ghraib fl-Iraq ġie mqabbad bin-nar waqt rewwixta.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Il-ħabs sar notorju wara li ġie skopert l-abbuż tal-priġunieri hemm wara li l-forzi ta-Istati Uniti ħadu r-riedni f’idejhom.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Fil-Grand Prix ta’ Singapore tal-2008, Piquet Jr. ħabat eżatt wara pit stop bikrija għal Fernando Alonso u, għalhekk, ħarġet il-karozza tas-sigurtà.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Meta l-karozzi ta’ quddiem Alonso daħlu biex jieħdu l-fjuwil taħt il-karozza tas-sigurtà, huwa qabeż ’il quddiem biex jieħu r-rebħa.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. ġie mkeċċi wara l-Grand Prix tal-Ungerija tal-2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Preċiżament fit-8:46 ta’ filgħodu, waqgħet ħemda madwar il-belt, li mmarkat il-mument eżatt meta l-ewwel ġett laqat il-bersall tiegħu.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Ġew immuntati żewġ raġġi ta' dawl immirati lejn is-sema bil-lejl.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Bħalissa għaddejja l-kostruzzjoni ta' ħames skyscrapers ġodda fuq is-sit, b’ċentru tat-trasport u park kommemorattiv fin-nofs.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Ix-show tal-PBS għandu aktar minn żewġ tużżani premjijiet Emmy, u din is-sensiela hija iqsar biss minn Sesame Street u Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Kull episodju tal-ispettaklu jiffoka fuq tema fi ktieb speċifiku u mbagħad jesplora dik it-tema permezz ta’ stejjer multipli.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Kull spettaklu jipprovdi wkoll rakkomandazzjonijiet għal kotba li għandhom ifittxuhom it-tfal meta jmorru fil-librerija tagħhom.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, minn WNED Buffalo (l-istazzjon ta’ oriġini ta’ Reading Rainbow) qal: "Reading Rainbow għallem lit-tfal ir-raġuni għaliex jaqraw,...l-imħabba għall-qari — [l-ispettaklu] ħeġġeġ lit-tfal biex jaqbdu ktieb u jaqraw."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Xi persuni, inkluż John Grant, iħossu li kemm il-kriżi tal-finanzjament kif ukoll bidla fil-filosofija tal-programmazzjoni edukattiva tat-televiżjoni wasslu biex jintemm is-serje.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Il-maltempata, li tinsab madwar 645 mil (1040 km) fil-Punent tal-gżejjer Cape Verde, probabbilment tispiċċa fix-xejn qabel thedded iż-żoni tal-art, jgħidu dawk li jbassru t-temp.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred bħalissa għandu irjieħ ta’ 105 mili fis-siegħa (165 km/siegħa) u jinsb miexi lejn il-majjistral.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred huwa l-iktar ċiklun tropikali b’saħħtu li qatt ġie rreġistrat s’issa fin-Nofsinhar u fil-Lvant tal-Atlantiku minn meta beda t-teħid ta’ ritratti bis-satellita, u huwa biss it-tielet l-akbar uragan rreġistrat fil-Lvant ta’ 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Fl-24 ta’ Settembru 1759, Arthur Guinness iffirma kera ta’ 9,000 sena għall-Birrerija St James’ Gate ġewwa Dublin, l-Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 sena wara, Guinness żviluppat f'negozju globali bi dħul ta' 10 biljun euro (US$14.7 biljun) kull sena.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, ko-sewwieq għat-tim tal-A1GP ta’ New Zealand, illum tniżżel fl-istorja billi saq l-iktar veloċi fuq il-Pont tal-Port ta’ Auckland li għandu 48 sena, ġewwa New Zealand, legalment.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Is-Sur Reid irnexxielu jsuq il-karozza A1GP tan-New Zealand, Black Beauty b’veloċitajiet ta’ aktar minn 160km/siegħa seba’ darbiet fuq il-pont.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Il-pulizija ta' New Zealand kellhom diffikultà biex jużaw il-pistoli tar-radar tal-veloċità tagħhom ħalli jaraw il-veloċità tas-Sur Reid minħabba li Black Beauty hija baxxa ħafna, u l-unika darba li l-pulizija rnexxielhom jieħdu qari tal-veloċità tas-Sur Reid kien meta naqqas il-veloċità għal 160km/siegħa.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Fl-aħħar 3 xhur, iktar minn 80 persuna arrestati ġew rilaxxati mill-faċilità Central Booking mingħajr ma ġew akkużati b'mod formali.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: F’April ta’ din is-sena, inħarġet ordni ta’ żamma temporanja mill-Imħallef Glynn kontra l-faċilità biex jiġi rinforzat il-ħelsien ta’ dawk miżmuma aktar minn 24 siegħa wara li ddaħlu u li ma rċevewx smigħ minn kummissarju tal-qorti.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Il-kummissarju jissettja l-kawzjoni, jekk tingħata, u jifformalizza l-akkużi sottomessi mill-uffiċjal li għamel l-arrest. Wara dan, l-akkużi jiddaħħlu fis-sistema tal-kompjuter tal-istat u l-każ jiġi traċċat.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Is-seduta ta’ smigħ timmarka wkoll id-data għad-dritt għal proċess bla dewmien tal-persuna suspettata.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, teżorier Awstraljan u r-raġel li x’aktarx jilħaq wara l-Prim Ministru John Howard bħala l-kap tal-partit Liberali tefa’ l-appoġġ tiegħu wara industrija tal-enerġija nukleari fl-Awstralja.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Is-Sur Costello qal li meta l-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija nukleari ssir ekonomikament vijabbli, l-Awstralja għandha tibda tużaha.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Jekk isir kummerċjali, għandna nieħduh. Fi kliem ieħor, m’hemm l-ebda oġġezzjoni fil-prinċipju għall-enerġija nukleari" qal is-Sur Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Skont l-Ansa, "il-pulizija kienu nkwetati b'żewġ aċċidenti ta' qtil tal-ogħla livell li huma kellhom il-biża' setgħu jqanqlu gwerra qalila tas-suċċessjoni.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Il-Pulizija qalet li Lo Piccolo kellu l-vantaġġ għax kien l-assistent l-iktar qrib Provenzano ġewwa Palermo u l-esperjenza kbira tiegħu rebħitlu r-rispett tal-ġenerazzjoni iktar anzjana tal-kapijiet kif segwew il-politika ta’ Provenzano li jżommu profil kemm jista’ jkun baxx waqt li jsaħħu n-netwerk tal-poter tagħhom.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Dawn il-kapijiet kienu ġew imrażżna minn Provenzano meta waqqaf il-ġwerra mmexxija minn Riina kontra l-istat u li ħasdet il-ħajja tal-ġellieda kontra l-Mafja Giovanni Falcone u Paolo Borsellino fl-1992."
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Is-CEO tal-Apple, Steve Jobs, żvela t-tagħmir billi tela’ fuq l-istejġ u ħareġ l-iPhone mill-but tal-jeans tiegħu.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Matul id-diskors tiegħu ta’ sagħtejn huwa ddikjara li "Illum Apple se terġa’ tivvinta t-telefon, Se ninżlu fl-istorja llum".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Il-Brażil huwa l-akbar pajjiż Kattoliku Ruman fid-Dinja, u l-Knisja Kattolika Rumana opponiet il-legalizzazzjoni taż-żwieġ bejn persuni tal-istess sess fil-pajjiż b’mod konsistenti.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Il-Kungress Nazzjonali tal-Brażil iddibatta l-legalizzazzjoni għal 10 snin, u żwiġijiet ċivili bħal dawn bħalissa huma legali biss ġewwa Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: L-abbozz oriġinali ġie ddraftjat minn Marta Suplicy, l-eks sindku ta' São Paulo. Il-leġiżlazzjoni proposta, wara li ġiet emendata, issa tinsab f'idejn Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Id-dimostranti jittamaw li jiġbru petizzjoni ta’ 1.2 miljun firma biex jippreżentawhom lill-Kungress Nazzjonali f’Novembru.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Wara li ħarġet fil-beraħ li ħafna familji kienu qed ifittxu għajnuna legali biex jiġġieldu l-iżgumbramenti, saret laqgħa fl-20 ta' Marzu fiċ-Ċentru Legali tal-Komunità ta' East Bay għall-vittmi tal-iskema qarrieqa rigward id-djar.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Meta l-inkwilini bdew jikkondividu dak li kien ġralhom, il-maġġoranza tal-familji involuti f'daqqa waħda rrealizzaw li Carolyn Wilson tal-OHA kienet serqet id-depożiti tas-sigurtà tagħhom, u ħarbet mill-belt.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Kerrejja f’Lockwood Gardens jemmnu li jista’ jkun hemm sa 40 familja oħra jew iktar li jiffaċċjaw żgumbrament, peress li saru jafu li l-pulizija tal-OHA qed jinvestigaw ukoll proprjetajiet ta’ djar tal-gvern oħra ġewwa Oakland li jistgħu jinqabdu fl-iskema qarrieqa tad-djar.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Il-banda kkanċellat l-ispettaklu fil-War Memorial Stadium ta’ Maui, li kellu jkollu attendenza ta' 9,000 persuna, u talbet skuża lis-segwaċi tagħha.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Il-kumpanija maniġerjali tal-banda, HK Management Inc., ma tat l-ebda raġuni inizjali meta kkanċellaw fl-20 ta’ Settembru, iżda l-għada qalet li kien tort ta’ raġunijiet loġistiċi.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: L-avukati Griegi famużi, Sakis Kechagioglou u George Nikolakopoulos ingħataw sentenza ta’ priġunerija fil-ħabs ta’ Ateni ġewwa Korydallus, peress li nstabu ħatja ta’ tixħim u korruzzjoni.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Bħala riżultat ta’ dan, ħareġ skandlu kbir fil-komunità legali Griega minħabba l-esponiment ta’ azzjonijiet illegali magħmulin minn imħallfin u avukati matul is-snin preċedenti.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Ftit ġimgħat ilu, wara l-informazzjoni ppubblikata mill-ġurnalista Makis Triantafylopoulos fis-show televiżiv popolari tiegħu "Zoungla" fuq l-Alpha TV, il-membru Parlamentari u avukat, Petros Mantouvalos ġie abdikat minħabba li membri tal-uffiċċju tiegħu kienu involuti f'tixħim illegali u korruzzjoni.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Barra minn hekk, l-imħallef ewlieni Evangelos Kalousis jinsab il-ħabs minħabba li nstab ħati ta’ korruzzjoni u mġieba deġenerata.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts irrifjuta b’mod ċar milli jgħid meta jemmen li tibda l-ħajja, mistoqsija importanti meta tikkunsidra l-etika tal-abort, u qal li ma jkunx etiku li jikkummenta dwar l-ispeċifiċitajiet tal-każijiet probabbli.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Madankollu, huwa tenna l-istqarrija li kien għamel qabel li Roe vs Wade kienet "ġurisprudenza stabbilita tal-pajjiż", u enfasizza l-importanza ta’ deċiżjonijiet konsistenti tal-Qorti Suprema.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Huwa kkonferma wkoll li jemmen fid-dritt impliċitu għall-privatezza li kienet tiddependi fuqu d-deċiżjoni Roe.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore kien spiċċa fil-quċċata tal-klassifika, sitt punti ’l fuq minn Noosa fit-tieni post.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Iż-żewġ naħat kellhom jiltaqgħu fis-semi finali ewlieni fejn Noosa ħarġu rebbieħa bi 11-il punt.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Imbagħad, Maroochydore rebaħ lil Caboolture fil-Finali Preliminari.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae hija speċi fil-familja ta' Dromaeosauridae u kuġina tal-Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Dan l-għasfur tal-priża miksi bir-rix u b'demm sħun kien maħsub li kien jimxi wieqaf fuq żewġ riġlejn bi dwiefer bil-ponta bħall-Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: It-tieni difer tagħha kien ikbar, li wassal għall-isem Hesperonychus li jfisser "difer tal-Punent."
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Minbarra t-tkissir tas-silġ, kundizzjonijiet estremi tat-temp xekklu l-isforzi ta’ salvataġġ.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman issuġġerixxa li l-kundizzjonijiet mhux se jitjiebu qabel xi ħin il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: L-ammont u l-ħxuna tal-pakkett tas-silġ, skont Pittman, huwa l-agħar li kien għall-bastimenti tal-foki fl-aħħar 15-il sena.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Illum ġie mħabbar fil-komunità tar-Red Lake waqt kienu qed isiru l-funerali ta' Jeff Weise u tlieta mid-disa’ vittmi, li student ieħor ġie arrestat b’konnessjoni mal-isparaturi fl-iskola li saru fil-21 ta’ Marzu.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: L-awtoritajiet ma qalux wisq uffiċjalment apparti mill-konferma tal-arrest li sar illum.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Madankollu, sors li kien jaf bl-investigazzjoni qal lill-Minneapolis Star-Tribune li kien Louis Jourdain, it-tifel tal-President tat-Tribali tar-Red Lake Floyd Jourdain, u li għandu sittax-il sena.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Mhux magħruf f’dan iż-żmien liema akkużi se jsiru jew x’wassal lill-awtoritajiet għat-tifel iżda bdew il-proċeduri tal-minorenni fil-qorti federali.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin qal ukoll li l-uffiċjali ddeċidew li jikkanċellaw it-tieni elezzjoni sabiex lill-Afgani jiffrankawlhom l-ispejjeż u r-riskju tas-sigurtà li ġġib magħha elezzjoni oħra.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Id-diplomatiċi qalu li sabu biżżejjed ambigwità fil-kostituzzjoni Afgana biex jiddeterminaw it-tieni elezzjoni mhix meħtieġa.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Dan jikkontradixxi r-rapporti preċedenti, li qalu li l-kanċellazzjoni tar-runoff kienet tkun kontra l-kostituzzjoni.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: L-ajruplan kien direzzjonat lejn Irkutsk u kien operat minn truppi interni.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Ġiet stabbilita inkjesta biex tinvestiga.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: L-Il-76 kien komponent ewlieni kemm tal-militar Russu kif ukoll ta’ dak Sovjetiku sa mis-sebgħinijiet, u kien diġà ra inċident serju fir-Russja x-xahar li għadda.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Fis-7 ta’ Ottubru, waqt it-tluq isseparat magna, mingħajr korrimenti. Ir-Russja ma użatx Il-76s għal żmien qasir wara dak l-inċident.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: 800 mil tas-Sistema tal-Pipeline Trans-Alaska ngħalqu wara t-tixrid ta' eluf ta' bramel ta' żejt mhux raffinat fin-Nofsinhar ta' Fairbanks, fl-Alaska.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Meta nqata’ d-dawl wara li sar test ta’ rutina tas-sistema tal-kontroll tan-nirien, dan ikkawża l-ftuħ ta’ valvi ta’ rilaxx u far żejt mhux raffinat ħdejn l-istazzjon tal-pompa Fort Greely Nru 9.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Il-ftuħ tal-valvi ppermetta rilaxx tal-pressjoni għas-sistema u ż-żejt għadda fuq pad għal tank li jesa' 55,000 barmil (2.3 miljun gallun).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Sa minn nhar l-Erbgħa wara nofsinhar, il-ventijiet tat-tank kienu għadhom qiegħdin inixxu probabbilment minħabba l-espansjoni termali fit-tank.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Żona oħra ta' konteniment sekondarju taħt it-tankijiet li kapaċi tesa' 104,500 barmil kienet għadha ma mtlietx kompletament.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Il-kummenti, diretti fuq it-televiżjoni, kienu l-ewwel darba li sorsi anzjani Iranjani ammettew li s-sanzjonijiet qed ikollhom effett.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Huma jinkludu restrizzjonijiet finanzjarji u projbizzjoni mill-Unjoni Ewropea fuq l-esportazzjoni taż-żejt mhux raffinat li minnu l-ekonomija Iranjana tirċievi 80 % tad-dħul barrani tagħha.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Fl-iktar rapport ta’ kull xahar reċenti tagħha, OPEC qalet li l-esportazzjonijiet ta’ żejt mhux raffinat naqsu għall-iktar livell baxx tagħhom fl-aħħar għoxrin sena b’2.8 miljun barmil kuljum.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Il-mexxej suprem tal-pajjiż, l-Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, iddeskriva d-dipendenza fuq iż-żejt bħala "nassa" li bdiet sa minn qabel ir-rivoluzzjoni Iżlamika tal-Iran fl-1979 u li l-pajjiż għandu jeħles lilu nnifsu minnha.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Meta l-kapsula tasal fid-Dinja u tidħol fl-atmosfera, f'xi l-5 ta' filgħodu (ħin tal-Lvant), mistennija li toħloq spettaklu tad-dawl sostanzjali għan-nies fil-Kalifornja tat-Tramuntana, fl-Oregon, fin-Nevada, u f'Utah.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Il-kapsula se tidher ħafna qisha kewkba feġġa għaddejja fis-sema.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Il-kapsula se tivvjaġġa b’madwar 12.8 km jew 8 mili kull sekonda, veloċi biżżejjed biex tmur minn San Francisco sa Los Angeles f’minuta.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust se jistabbilixxi rekord ġdid għall-ewwel darba bħala l-iktar inġenju tal-ispazju li jirritorna fid-Dinja malajr, u kiser ir-rekord preċedenti stabbilit f’Mejju tal-1969 waqt ir-ritorn tal-modulu ta’ kmand Apollo X.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: Tom Duxbury, il-maniġer tal-proġett Stardust qal: “Se tgħaddi minn fuq il-kosta tal-Punent tat-Tramuntana ta’ Kalifornja u se tillumina s-sema minn Kalifornja tgħaddi minn Oregon ċentrali u tibqa’ għaddejja minn Nevada u Idaho u lejn Utah”.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Id-deċiżjoni tas-Sur Rudd li jiffirma l-ftehim ta’ Kyoto dwar il-klima tiżola lill-Istati Uniti, li issa se tkun l-unika nazzjon żviluppat li ma rratifikatx il-ftehim.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: L-eks gvern konservattiv tal-Awstralja rrifjuta li jirratifika Kyoto, u qal li ssir ħsara lill-ekonomija bid-dipendenza qawwija tiegħu fuq l-esportazzjonijiet tal-faħam, filwaqt li pajjiżi bħall-Indja u ċ-Ċina ma kinux marbutin mill-miri tal-emissjonijiet.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Dan huwa l-akbar akkwist fl-istorja ta’ eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Il-kumpanija tittama li tiddiversifika s-sorsi ta’ profitt tagħha u tikseb popolarità f’żoni fejn Skype għandu pożizzjoni kbira, bħaċ-Ċina, l-Ewropa tal-Lvant, u l-Brażil.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Ix-xjentisti ssuspettaw li Enceladus huwa ġeoloġikament attiv u sors potenzjali taċ-ċirku E tas-silġ ta’ Saturnu.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus huwa l-iktar oġġett li jirrifletti fis-sistema solari, u jirrifletti bejn wieħed u ieħor 90 fil-mija tax-xemx li tolqtu.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Il-pubblikatur tal-logħob Konami ddikjaraw illum f’gazzetta Ġappuniża li mhux se joħorġu l-logħba “Six Days in Fallujah” (“Sitt Ijiem Ġewwa Fallujah”).
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Il-logħba hija bbażata fuq it-Tieni Battalja ta’ Fallujah, battalja vjolenti bejn il-forzi Amerikani u Iraqqini.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: L-ACMA sabet ukoll li minkejja li l-vidjo ġie mxandar fuq l-Internet, Big Brother ma kisritx il-liġijiet taċ-ċensura tal-kontenut onlajn peress li l-midja ma kinitx ġiet maħżuna fuq is-sit web ta’ Big Brother.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: L-Att dwar is-Servizzi tax-Xandir jipprovdi għar-regolamentazzjoni tal-kontenut tal-Internet, madankollu biex ikun ikkunsidrat bħala kontenut tal-Internet, għandu jirrisjedi fiżikament fuq server.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: L-ambaxxata tal-Istati Uniti li hemm f'Nairobi, fil-Kenya ħarġet twissija li "estremisti mis-Somalja" qed jippjanaw li jwettqu attakki ta' bombi suwiċidi fil-Kenja u l-Etjopja.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: L-Istati Uniti jgħidu li rċevew informazzjoni minn sors mhux żvelat li speċifikament issemmi l-użu ta' bombi suwiċidi biex jisplodu "postijiet prominenti" fl-Etjopja u l-Kenja.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Ħafna qabel “The Daily Show” u “The Colbert Report”, Heck u Johnson kellhom viżjoni li jagħmlu pubblikazzjoni li kienet se tkun parodija tal-aħbarijiet—u r-rappurtar tal-aħbarijiet—meta kienu studenti ġewwa UW fl-1988.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Sa minn meta bdiet, The Onion saret imperu ta’ parodija ta’ aħbarijiet ta’ vera, b’edizzjoni stampata, sit web li ġibed 5,000,000 viżitatur uniku fix-xahar ta’ Ottubru, reklami personali, netwerk ta’ aħbarijiet ta’ 24 siegħa, podcasts, u atlas globali mniedi dan l-aħħar imsejjaħ “Our Dumb World” (“Id-Dinja Belha Tagħna”).
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore u l-Ġeneral Tommy Franks każwalment jgħidu malajr il-headlines favoriti tagħhom (ta' Gore kien meta The Onion irrapportat li hu u Tipper kienu qed jagħmlu l-aqwa sess ta' ħajjithom wara t-telfa tiegħu fil-Kulleġġ Elettorali tal-2000).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Ħafna mill-kittieba tagħhom baqa' jkollhom influwenza kbira fuq l-ispettakli ta’ parodija tal-aħbarijiet ta’ Jon Stewart u Stephen Colbert.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: L-avveniment artistiku huwa wkoll parti minn kampanja mis-Sala tal-Belt ta’ Bukarest li tipprova terġa’ tniedi l-immaġni tal-belt kapitali Rumena bħala metropoli kreattiva u kkulurita.
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: Il-belt se tkun l-ewwel waħda fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa li tospita CowParade, l-ikbar avveniment tal-arti pubblika fid-dinja, bejn Ġunju u Awwissu ta’ din is-sena.
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: It-tħabbira tal-lum estendiet ukoll l-impenn li l-gvern għamel f'Marzu ta' din is-sena li jiffinanzja aktar vaguni.
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: 300 oħra jammontaw għal 1,300 vagun li jridu jiġu miksuba biex jitnaqqas l-iffullar żejjed.
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Christopher Garcia, kelliem għad-Dipartiment tal-Pulizija ta’ Los Angeles, qal li r-raġel suspettat ħati qiegħed jiġi investigat talli daħal f’postijiet mingħajr permess pjuttost milli għal vandaliżmu.
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: It-tabella ma saritilhiex ħsara fiżika; il-modifika saret bl-użu ta' tarpolini suwed iddekorati bis-sinjali tal-paċi u qalb biex tinbidel l-"O" u issir "e" żgħira.
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: Il-marea ħamra hija kkawżata minn konċentrazzjoni ogħla min-normal ta’ Karenia brevis, organiżmu tal-baħar b’ċellula waħda li jseħħ b’mod naturali.
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: Fatturi naturali jistgħu jidħlu fuq xulxin biex jipproduċu kundizzjonijiet ideali, u jwasslu biex din l-alka tiżdied b’mod drammatiku.
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: L-alka tipproduċi newrotossina li tista’ tiddiżattiva n-nervituri kemm fil-bnedmin kif ukoll fil-ħut.
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: Il-ħut spiss imutu minħabba konċentrazzjonijiet għoljin tat-tossina fl-ilma.
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: Il-bnedmin jistgħu jiġu affettwati billi jieħdu fin-nifs ilma affettwat meħud fl-arja mir-riħ u l-mewġ.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: Fil-quċċata tiegħu, iċ-Ċiklun Tropikali Gonu, imsemmi għal borża ta’ weraq tal-palm bil-lingwa tal-Maldivi, laħaq irjieħ sostnuti ta’ 240 kilometru fis-siegħa (149 mil fis-siegħa).
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Sa kmieni llum, ir-riħ kien madwar 83 km/h, u kien mistenni li jkompli jitlef il-qawwa tiegħu.
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: Nhar l-Erbgħa, l-Assoċjazzjoni Nazzjonali tal-Baskitbol tal-Istati Uniti (NBA) issospendiet l-istaġun professjonali tal-baskitbol tagħha minħabba tħassib rigward COVID-19.
text_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.

text: Id-deċiżjoni tal-NBA segwiet il-fatt li plejer tal-Utah Jazz irriżulta li kien pożittiv għall-virus COVID-19.
text_en: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.

text_en: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.

text_en: That means everything has to be put back," said researcher at the Rift Valley Research Service in Ethiopia and a co-author of the study, Berhane Asfaw.

text_en: Until now, AOL has been able to move and develop the IM market at its own pace, due to its widespread use within the United States.

text: B'dan l-arranġament fis-seħħ, din il-libertà tista' tintemm.
text_en: With this arrangement in place, this freedom might end.

text: In-numru ta’ persuni li jużaw is-servizzi ta' Yahoo! u Microsoft flimkien se jikkompeti man-numru ta’ klijenti ta’ AOL.
text_en: The number of users of the Yahoo! and Microsoft services combined will rival the number of AOL's customers.

text: Il-bank Northern Rock kien ġie nazzjonalizzat fl-2008 wara r-rivelazzjoni li l-kumpanija kienet irċeviet appoġġ ta’ emerġenza mill-Gvern tar-Renju Unit.
text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text: Northern Rock kellha bżonn appoġġ minħabba l-esponiment tagħha matul il-kriżi tal-ipoteki subprime fl-2007.
text_en: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.

text: Virgin Group ta’ Sir Richard Branson kellha offerta għall-bank miċħuda qabel in-nazzjonalizzazzjoni tal-bank.
text_en: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.

text: Fl-2010, filwaqt li nazzjonalizzat, il-bank ewlieni attwali Northern Rock plc ġie sseparat mill-“bank ħażin”, Northern Rock (Ġestjoni tal-Assi).
text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text: Virgin xtraw biss il-'bank tajjeb' ta' Northern Rock, mhux il-kumpanija tal-ġestjoni tal-assi.
text_en: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.

text: Dan probabbilment huwa l-ħames darba fl-istorja li n-nies osservaw dak li rriżulta li kien materjal marzjan ikkonfermat kimikament qed jaqa' fid-Dinja.
text_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.

text: Mill-madwar 24,000 meteoriti magħrufin li waqgħu fid-Dinja, madwar 34 biss ġew ivverifikati li għandhom oriġini marzjana.
text_en: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.

text: Ħmistax minn dawn il-ġebel huma attribwiti għax-xita ta’ meteoriti ta’ Lulju li għadda.
text_en: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.

text: Uħud mill-ħaġar, li huma rari ħafna fid-Dinja, qed jinbiegħu minn US$11,000 sa $22,500 għal kull uqija, li huwa madwar għaxar darbiet iktar mill-prezz tad-deheb.
text_en: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

text: Wara t-tellieqa, Keselowski jibqa’ l-kap tal-Kampjonat tas-Sewwieqa b’2,250 punt.
text_en: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.

text: Seba’ punti wara, Johnson jinsab fit-tieni post b’2,243 punt.
text_en: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.

text: Fit-tielet post, Hamlin jinsab għoxrin punt wara, iżda ħames punti qabel Bowyer. Kahne u Truex, Jr. huma fil-ħames u s-sitt post rispettivament b’2,220 u 2,207 punt.
text_en: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.

text: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, u Harvick jieħdu l-aqwa għaxar pożizzjonijiet għall-Kampjonat tas-Sewwieqa filwaqt li jibqa’ erba' tlielaq fl-istaġun.
text_en: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.

text: In-Nejvi tal-Istati Uniti qalet ukoll li qed jinvestigaw l-inċident.
text_en: The US Navy also said they were investigating the incident.

text: Huma qalu wkoll fi stqarrija, "L-ekwipaġġ bħalissa qed jipprova jiddetermina l-aħjar metodu għall-estrazzjoni sikura tal-vapur".
text_en: They also said in a statement, "The crew is currently working to determine the best method of safely extracting the ship".

text: Il-vapur, tal-klassi Avenger u speċjalizzat fil-kontromiżuri għall-mini, kien fi triqtu lejn Puerto Princesa f'Palawan.
text_en: An Avenger class mine countermeasures ship, the ship was on its way to Puerto Princesa in Palawan.

text: Huwa assenjat lis-Seba’ Flotta tal-Forza Navali tal-Istati Uniti u bbażat f’Sasebo, Nagasaki fil-Ġappun.
text_en: It is assigned to the U.S. Navy’s Seventh Fleet and based in Sasebo, Nagasaki in Japan.

text: L-attakkanti ta’ Mumbai waslu permezz ta’ dgħajsa fis-26 ta’ Novembru 2008, u ġabu magħhom granati, armi awtomatiċi u laqtu bosta miri inkluż l-istazzjon tal-ferrovija Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus iffullat u l-famuż Taj Mahal Hotel.
text_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on Novemeber 26, 2008, bringing with them grenades, automatic weapons and hit multiple targets including the crowded Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus railway station and the famous Taj Mahal Hotel.

text: It-tiftix u l-ġbir ta’ informazzjoni ta’ David Headley għenu biex tkun tista’ ssir l-operazzjoni mill-10 persuni armati mill-grupp militanti Pakistani Laskhar-e-Taiba.
text_en: David Headley's scouting and information gathering had helped to enable the operation by the 10 gunmen from the Pakistani militant group Laskhar-e-Taiba.

text: L-attakk tefa’ pressjoni kbira fuq ir-relazzjonijiet bejn l-Indja u l-Pakistan.
text_en: The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.

text: Akkumpanjat minn dawn l-uffiċjali, huwa assigura liċ-ċittadini ta' Texas li kienu qed jittieħdu passi biex tiġi protetta s-sikurezza tal-pubbliku.
text_en: Accompanied by those officials, he assured Texas citizens that steps were being taken to protect the public's safety.

text: Perry speċifikament qal, "Ftit hemm postijiet fid-dinja li huma mgħammra aħjar biex jiffaċċjaw l-isfida magħmula f’dan il-każ."
text_en: Perry specifically said, "There are few places in the world better equipped to meet the challenge that is posed in this case."

text: Il-gvernatur iddikjara wkoll, "Illum sirna nafu li xi tfal ta’ età skolastika ġew identifikati bħala li kellhom kuntatt mal-pazjent."
text_en: The governor also stated, "Today, we learned that some school aged children have been identified as having had contact with the patient."

text: Huwa kompla jgħid, "Dan il-każ huwa serju. Serrħu moħħkom li s-sistema tagħna qed taħdem tajjeb kif suppost."
text_en: He went on to say, "This case is serious. Rest assured that our system is working as well as it should."

text: Jekk ikun hemm konferma, is-sejba tagħlaq it-tfittxija ta’ tmien snin ta’ Allen għall-Musashi.
text_en: If confirmed, the find completes Allen's eight-year search for the Musashi.

text: Wara mmappjar ta’ qiegħ il-baħar, ir-relitt instab bl-użu ta' ROV.
text_en: Following seabed mapping the wreck was found using an ROV.

text: Wieħed mill-iktar nies sinjuri fid-dinja, Allen irrapporta li investa ħafna mill-ġid tiegħu fl-esplorazzjoni tal-baħar u beda t-tfittxija tiegħu biex isib il-Musashi bħala riżultat ta’ interess tiegħu tul ħajtu kollha fil-gwerra.
text_en: One of the world's richest people, Allen has reportedly invested much of his wealth in marine exploration and began his quest to find the Musashi out of a lifelong interest in the war.

text: Hija kisbet akklamazzjoni importanti matul iż-żmien tagħha ġewwa Atlanta u ġiet rikonoxxuta għal edukazzjoni urbana innovattiva.
text_en: She gained critical acclaim during her time in Atlanta and was recognized for innovative urban education.

text: Fl-2009, ingħatat it-titlu ta’ Supretendent Nazzjonali tas-Sena.
text_en: In 2009 she was awarded the title of National Superintendent of the Year.

text: Fiż-żmien tal-premju, l-iskejjel ta’ Atlanta raw titjib kbir fuq il-punteġġi tat-test.
text_en: At the time of the award, Atlanta schools had seen a large improvement on test scores.

text: Ftit żmien wara dan, “The Atlanta Journal-Constitution” ippubblikaw rapport dwar il-problemi bir-riżultati tat-test.
text_en: Shortly after, The Atlanta Journal-Constitution published a report showing problems with test results.

text: Ir-rapport wera li l-marki tat-testijiet kienu żdiedu b'mod rapidu li ma jitwemminx, u allega li l-iskola internament sabet xi problemi imma m'aġixxietx fuq dak li sabet.
text_en: The report showed test scores had increased implausibly fast, and alleged the school internally detected problems but didn't act on the findings.

text: Wara dan, l-evidenza uriet li l-karti tat-test kienu mbagħbsa u Hall, u 34 uffiċjali oħra tal-edukazzjoni, ġew akkużati fl-2013.
text_en: Evidence thereafter indicated test papers were tampered with Hall, along with 34 other education officials, was indicted in 2013.

text: Il-gvern Irlandiż qed jenfasizza l-urġenza tal-leġiżlazzjoni parlamentari biex tirranġa s-sitwazzjoni.
text_en: The Irish government is stressing the urgency of parliamentary legislation to rectify the situation.

text: "Issa huwa importanti kemm mill-perspettiva tas-saħħa pubblika kif ukoll minn dik tal-ġustizzja kriminali li l-leġiżlazzjoni tiġi promulgata kemm jista’ jkun malajr", qal kelliem għall-gvern.
text_en: "It is now important from both a public health and criminal justice perspective that the legislation be enacted as soon as possible", said a government spokesperson.

text: Il-Ministru tas-Saħħa esprima tħassib kemm għall-benesseri tal-individwi li jieħdu vantaġġ mil-legalità temporanja tas-sustanzi involuti, kif ukoll għall-kundanni relatati mad-droga mogħtija minn meta daħlu fis-seħħ il-bidliet li issa mhumiex kostituzzjonali.
text_en: The Health Minister expressed concern both for the welfare of individuals taking advantage of the temporary legality of the substances involved, and for drug-related convictions handed down since the now-unconstitutional changes came into effect.

text_en: He was staying in the team hotel ahead of a match planned for Sunday against Bolonia.

text_en: The bus was headed to Six Flags St. Louis in Missouri for the band to play to a sold-out crowd.

text_en: Fire captain Scott Kouns said, "It was a hot day in the Santa Clara with temperatures in the 90s.

text_en: Any length of time trapped on a roller coaster would be uncomfortable, to say the least, and it took at least an hour to get the first person off the ride."

text_en: Schumacher who retired in 2006 after winning the Formula 1 championship seven times, was due to replace the injured Felipe Massa.

text: Il-Brażiljan sofra ġrieħi serji f’rasu wara li ħabat waqt il-Grand Prix tal-Ungerija tal-2009.
text_en: The Brazilian suffered a serious head injury after a crash during the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Massa għandu jibqa’ barra għal mill-inqas il-kumplament tal-istaġun tal-2009.
text_en: Massa is due to be out for at least the rest of the 2009 season.

text: Il-Ministru Presidenzjali Rodrigo Arias qal li Arias irriżulta pożittiv għal każ ħafif tal-virus.
text_en: Arias tested positive for a mild case of the virus, Presidential Minister Rodrigo Arias said.

text: Il-kundizzjoni tal-president hija stabbli, għalkemm huwa se jkun iżolat id-dar għal diversi jiem.
text_en: The president's condition is stable, though he will be isolated at home for several days.

text: Apparti d-deni u l-uġigħ fi ġriżmejja, jiena nħossni tajjeb u kapaċi nwettaq ix-xogħol tiegħi bit-telexogħol.
text_en: "Apart from the fever and a sore throat, I feel well and in good shape to carry out my work by telecommuting.

text: Nistenna li nirritorna għad-dmirijiet kollha tiegħi nhar it-Tnejn," qal Arias fi stqarrija.
text_en: I expect to return to all my duties on Monday," Arias said in a statement.

text: Felicia, li darba kienet maltempata tal-Kategorija 4 fuq l-Iskala tal-Uragani Saffir-Simpson, iddgħajfet għal depressjoni tropikali qabel ma sfat fix-xejn nhar it-Tlieta.
text_en: Felicia, once a Category 4 storm on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale, weakened to a tropical depression before dissipating Tuesday.

text: Il-fdalijiet tiegħu pproduċew xita fil-biċċa l-kbira tal-gżejjer, għalkemm s’issa, ma ġiet irrappurtata l-ebda ħsara jew għargħar.
text_en: Its remnants produced showers across most of the islands, though as of yet, no damage or flooding has been reported.

text: Il-preċipitazzjoni, li laħqet 6.34 pulzieri f'gejġ f'Oahu, kienet deskritta bħala "benefiċjarja".
text_en: The precipitation, reaching 6.34 inches at a gauge on Oahu, was described as "beneficial".

text: Ftit mix-xita kienet akkumpanjata minn maltempati bir-ragħad u sajjetti frekwenti.
text_en: Some of the rainfall was accompanied by thunderstorms and frequent lightning.

text: It-Twin Otter kien qed jipprova jillandja f'Kokoda lbieraħ bħala t-Titjira CG4684 ta' Airlines PNG, imma kien diġà abortixxa darba.
text_en: The Twin Otter had been trying to land at Kokoda yesterday as Airlines PNG Flight CG4684, but had aborted once already.

text: Madwar għaxar minuti qabel ma kellha tillandja wara t-tieni approċċ tagħha, sparixxiet.
text_en: About ten minutes before it was due to land from its second approach it disapeared.

text: Il-post tal-ħabta ġie lokalizzat illum u tant huwa inaċċessibbli li żewġ pulizija ġew imniżżlin fil-ġungla biex jagħmlu hike sal-post u jaraw jekk isibux xi superstiti.
text_en: The crash site was located today and is so inaccessable that two policemen were dropped into the jungle in order to hike to the scene and seek survivors.

text_en: The search had been hampered by the same bad weather that had caused the aborted landing.

text: Skont ir-rapporti, appartament fi Triq Macbeth sploda minħabba tnixxija ta' gass.
text_en: According to reports, an apartment on Macbeth Street exploded due to a gas leak.

text: Uffiċjal mal-kumpanija tal-gass kien qed jirrapporta fil-post wara li ġar ċempel rigward tnixxija tal-gass.
text_en: An official with the gas company was reporting to the scene after a neighbor called about a gas leak.

text: Meta wasal l-uffiċjal, l-appartament sploda.
text_en: When the official arrived, the apartment exploded.

text: Ma ġewx irrappurtati korrimenti serji, iżda mill-inqas ħames persuni li kienu fuq il-post waqt l-isplużjoni ġew trattati għal sintomi ta’ xokk.
text_en: No major injuries were reported, but at least five people on scene at the time of the explosion were treated for symptoms of shock.

text: Ma kien hemm ħadd fl-appartament.
text_en: No one was inside the apartment.

text: Dak iż-żmien, kważi 100 resident ġew evakwati miż-żona.
text_en: At the time, nearly 100 residents were evacuated from the area.

text: Kemm il-golf kif ukoll ir-rugby huma mistennija li jirritornaw fil-Logħob Olimpiku.
text_en: Both golf and rugby are set to return to the Olympic Games.

text: Il-Kumitat Olimpiku Internazzjonali vvota biex jinkludi l-isports fil-laqgħa tal-bord eżekuttiv tiegħu ġewwa Berlin illum. Ir-rugby, b'mod speċifiku r-rugby union, u l-golf intgħażlu fuq ħames sports oħra biex jitqiesu sabiex jipparteċipaw fl-Olimpjadi.
text_en: The International Olympic Committee voted to include the sports at its executive board meeting in Berlin today. Rugby, specifically rugby union, and golf were selected over five other sports to be considered to participate in the Olympics.

text: L-isquash, il-karate u l-isports fuq ir-roti ppruvaw jidħlu fil-programm Olimpiku, bħalma għamlu l-baseball u s-softball, li ġew ivvutati barra mill-Logħob Olimpiku fl-2005.
text_en: Squash, karate and roller sports tried to get onto the Olympic program as well as baseball and softball, which were voted out of the Olympic Games in 2005.

text: Il-vot għad irid jiġi rratifikat mill-IOC sħiħ fil-laqgħa tiegħu ta' Ottubru f'Copenhagen.
text_en: The vote must still be ratified by the full IOC at it's October meeting in Copenhagen.

text_en: Not all were supportive of the inclusion of the women’s ranks.

text_en: 2004 Olympic silver medallist Amir Khan said, "Deep down I think women shouldn’t fight. That’s my opinion."

text_en: Despite his comments he said he will be supporting the British competitors at the 2012 Olympics being held in London.

text_en: The presenter, who was arrested at the scene, denied the attack and claimed he used the pole to protect himself from bottles being thrown at him by up to thirty people.

text_en: Blake was also convicted of attempting to pervert the course of justice.

text_en: The judge told Blake it was "almost inevitable" he was going to be sent to jail.

text_en: Dark energy is a completely invisible force that is constantly acting upon the universe.

text_en: Its existence is known only because of its effects on the expansion of the universe.

text_en: Scientists have discovered landforms littered across the moon's surface called lobate scarps that have apparently resulted from the moon's shrinking very slowly.

text: Dawn l-iskarps kienu nstabu madwar il-qamar kollu u jidher li ġew affettwati minimament mit-temp, li jindika li l-avvenimenti ġeoloġiċi li ħolquhom kienu pjuttost reċenti.
text_en: These scarps were found all over the moon and appear to be minimally weathered, indicating that the geologic events that created them were fairly recent.

text: Din it-teorija tikkontradixxi l-asserzjoni li l-qamar huwa kompletament nieqes mill-attività ġeoloġika.
text_en: This theory contradicts the claim that the moon is completely devoid of geologic activity.

text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: It-tbassir tax-xjentisti fiċ-Ċentru Nazzjonali tal-Uragani huwa li Danielle se titqawwa u ssir uragan sa nhar l-Erbgħa.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Peress li l-maltempata hija ’l bogħod mill-art, jibqa’ jkun diffiċli li wieħed jevalwa l-impatt potenzjali fuq l-Istati Uniti jew il-Karibew.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Imwieled fil-belt kapitali Kroata, Żagreb, Bobek kiseb fama waqt li kien jilgħab għal Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Huwa ngħaqad magħhom fl-1945 u dam sal-1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Matul iż-żmien tiegħu mat-tim, huwa skorja 403 gowl f’468 dehra.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Ħadd ieħor qatt ma deher iktar jew skorja iktar gowls għall-klabb minn Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Fl-1995, ġie vvutat bħala l-aqwa plejer fl-istorja ta’ Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Iċ-ċelebrazzjonijiet bdew bi spettaklu speċjali mill-grupp magħruf mad-dinja kollha Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Ġie segwit mill-Orkestra Sinfonika tal-Istat ta’ Istanbul, banda Janissarja, u l-kantanti Fatih Erkoç u Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Wara, id-Dirwixi tad-Tidwir telgħu fuq il-palk.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Id-diva Torka Sezen Aksu għamlet esibizzjonijiet mat-tenur Taljan Alessandro Safina u l-kantanta Griega Haris Alexiou
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Bħala għeluq, il-grupp taż-żfin Tork Nar ta' Anatolja ppreżentaw l-ispettaklu "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, sewwieq tal-muturi ta’ 13-il sena, miet wara li kien involut f’ħabta fl-Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Waqt li kien qed idur id-dawra ta' tħejjija għat-tellieqa, Lenz waqa' minn fuq ir-rota tiegħu, u mbagħad intlaqat minn Xavier Zayat, li wkoll kien se jtellaq fit-tellieqa.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Huwa ngħata attenzjoni immedjata mill-istaff mediku fuq it-track u ġie ttrasportat lejn sptar lokali fejn, wara, miet.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat ma weġġax fl-inċident.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Rigward is-sitwazzjoni finanzjarja globali, Zapatero kompla billi qal li "s-sistema finanzjarja hija parti mill-ekonomija, parti kruċjali.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Għandna kriżi finanzjarja li ilha sena, li kellha l-aktar mument akut tagħha fl-aħħar xahrejn, u naħseb li issa s-swieq finanzjarji qed jibdew jirkupraw."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Il-ġimgħa li għaddiet, Naked News ħabbru li se jżidu drammatikament il-mandat tal-lingwa internazzjonali tagħhom għar-rappurtar tal-aħbarijiet, bi tliet xandiriet ġodda.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Wara li kienet diġà qed tirrapporta bl-Ingliż u l-Ġappuniż, l-organizzazzjoni globali issa qed tniedi programmi bl-Ispanjol, it-Taljan u l-Korean, għat-televixin, il-web, u l-apparat mobbli.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Fortunatament ma ġrali xejn, imma rajt xena makabra, meta n-nies ippruvaw ikissru t-twieqi biex joħorġu.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: In-nies kienu qed jolqtu l-ħġieġ bis-siġġijiet, iżda t-twieqi ma kinux jinkisru.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Waħda mill-ħġiġiet fl-aħħar inkisret, u bdew ħerġin mit-tieqa," qal is-superstitu Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: L-istilel jitfgħu d-dawl u s-sħana minħabba l-enerġija magħmula meta l-atomi tal-idroġenu jingħaqdu (jew iġonġu) flimkien biex jiffurmaw elementi itqal.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Ix-xjentisti qed jaħdmu biex joħolqu reattur li jista’ jagħmel l-enerġija bl-istess mod.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Din, iżda, hija problema diffiċli ħafna biex insolvuha u jridu jgħaddu ħafna snin qabel naraw reatturi ta' fużjoni utli mibnijin.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Il-labra tal-azzar titla' fil-wiċċ tal-ilma minħabba t-tensjoni tas-superfiċje.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: It-tensjoni tal-wiċċ isseħħ minħabba li l-molekuli tal-ilma fil-wiċċ tal-ilma huma attirati b’mod qawwi lejn xulxin aktar milli huma attirati lejn il-molekuli tal-arja ta’ fuqhom.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Il-molekuli tal-ilma jagħmlu ġilda inviżibbli fuq il-wiċċ tal-ilma li tippermetti li affarijiet bħal labra jifflowtjaw fuq l-ilma.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Ix-xafra fuq skejt tas-silġ moderna għandha tarf doppju b’ħofra konkava bejniethom. Iż-żewġt itruf jippermettu kontroll aħjar tas-silġ, anke meta jkunu mmejjlin.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Minħabba li l-parti t’isfel tax-xafra hija kemmxejn mgħawwġa, meta x-xafra tiġi mmejla fuq naħa waħda jew oħra, it-tarf li jkun f’kuntatt mas-silġ jitgħawweġ ukoll.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Dan jikkawża lill-iskejter idur. Jekk l-iskejts ixeqilbu lejn il-lemin, l-iskejter idur lejn il-lemin, jekk l-iskejts ixeqilbu lejn ix-xellug, l-iskejter idur lejn il-xellug.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Biex imorru lura għal-livell ta' enerġija preċedenti tagħhom, huma jridu jeħilsu mill-enerġija addizzjonali li ħadu mid-dawl.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Huma jagħmlu hekk billi jirilaxxaw partikula żgħira tad-dawl imsejħa "foton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Ix-xjentisti jsejħu dan il-proċess "emissjoni ta’ radjazzjoni stimulata" minħabba li l-atomi huma stimulati mid-dawl qawwi, u jikkawżaw l-emissjoni ta’ foton ta’ dawl, u d-dawl huwa tip ta’ radjazzjoni.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: L-istampa li jmiss turi l-atomi jarmu l-fotoni. Naturalment, fir-realtà, il-fotoni huma ħafna iżgħar minn dawk fl-istampa.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Il-fotoni huma saħansitra iżgħar mill-affarijiet li huma magħmulin minnhom l-atomi!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Wara mijiet ta' sigħat ta' tħaddim il-filament fil-bozza eventwalment jinħaraq u l-bozza tad-dawl ma taħdimx aktar.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Il-bozza tad-dawl imbagħad trid tinbidel. Jeħtieġ li toqgħod attent meta tibdel il-bozza tad-dawl.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: L-ewwel, l-iswiċċ għall-bozza jrid ikun mitfi jew il-kejbil ikun maqlugħ.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Dan għaliex l-elettriku li jidħol fis-sokit fejn tpoġġi l-parti metallika tal-bozza jista' jagħtik xokk elettriku sever jekk tmiss in-naħa ta' ġewwa tas-sokit jew il-bażi tal-metall tal-bozza waqt li tkun għadha parzjalment fis-sokit.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Il-qalb hija l-organu ċentrali tas-sistema ċirkolatorja, li tippompja d-demm.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Id-demm jitlaq mill-qalb permezz ta’ tubi msejħa arterji u jerġa’ lura fil-qalb permezz ta’ tubi msejħa vini. L-iżgħar tubi jissejħu kapillari.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Is-snien tat-triċeratops kienu kapaċi jkissru mhux il-weraq biss iżda anke fergħat u għeruq iebsin ħafna.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Xi xjenzati jaħsbu li t-Triceratops kienu jieklu ċikadi, li huma tip ta’ pjanta li kienet komuni fil-Kretaċju.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Dawn il-pjanti jidhru qishom siġra żgħira tal-palm b'kuruna ta' weraq b'xifer jaqta' u bil-ponta.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triċeratops seta’ juża l-munqar b’saħħtu tiegħu biex ineħħi l-weraq qabel jiekol iz-zokk.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Xjentisti oħra jargumentaw li dawn il-pjanti huma velenużi ħafna u allura huwa improbabbli li kielhom xi dinosawru, anki jekk illum il-folivoru (“sloth”) u annimali oħra bħall-pappagall (dixxendent tad-dinosawri) jistgħu jieklu weraq velenuż jew frott.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: X'effett ikollha fuqi l-ġibda tal-gravità ta’ Io? Jekk toqgħod fuq il-wiċċ ta’ Io, int tkun tiżen inqas milli tiżen fid-Dinja.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Persuna li tiżen 200 libbra (90 kg) fuq id-Dinja jkun jiżen madwar 36 libbra (16-il kg) fuq Io. Mela l-gravità, naturalment, tiġbed inqas fuqek.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Ix-Xemx m'għandhiex qoxra bħad-Dinja li tista' toqgħod fuqha. Ix-Xemx kollha hija magħmula minn gassijiet, nar, u plażma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Il-gass jitraqqaq iktar ma tmur ’il bogħod miċ-ċentru tax-Xemx.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Il-parti ta' barra li tidher meta nħarsu lejn ix-Xemx tissejjaħ il-fotosfera, li tfisser "ballun tad-dawl".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Madwar tlett elef sena wara, fl-1610, l-astronomu Taljan Galileo Galilei uża teleskopju biex josserva li Venus għandha l-fażijiet, kif għandu l-qamar.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Il-fażijiet jiġru għax in-naħa ta’ Venere (jew tal-Qamar) faċċata tax-Xemx biss hija mdawla. Il-fażijiet ta’ Venere sostnew it-teorija ta’ Copernicus li l-pjaneti jduru max-Xemx.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Imbagħad, ftit snin wara fl-1639, astronomu Ingliż li jismu Jeremiah Horrocks osserva transitu ta’ Venere.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: L-Ingilterra kienet esperjenzat perjodu twil ta’ paċi wara r-rikonkwista tad-Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Madankollu fid-991 Ethelred iffaċċja flotta Vikinga ikbar minn kwalunkwe waħda minn ta’ Guthrum is-seklu qabel.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Din il-flotta kienet immexxija minn Olaf Trygvasson, Norveġiż b'ambizzjonijiet li joħroġ lil pajjiżu mid-dominazzjoni Daniża.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Wara t-telfiet militari tal-bidu, Ethelred kien kapaċi jasal fi qbil ma' Olaf, li mar lura fin-Norveġja biex jipprova jikseb is-saltna tiegħu imma ma rnexxilux għal kollox.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul huwa l-uniku alfabet ivvintat apposta li jintuża b’mod popolari ta' kuljum. L-alfabet ġie ivvintat fl-1444 fi żmien ir-Re Sejong (1418 - 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Ir-Re Sejong kien ir-raba’ re tad-Dinastija Joseon u huwa wieħed mill-aktar rejiet irrispettati.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Oriġinarjament, huwa semma l-alfabet Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, li tfisser "il-ħsejjes korretti għall-istruzzjoni tan-nies".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Hemm ħafna teoriji dwar kif inħoloq is-Sanskrit. Waħda minnhom hija dwar migrazzjoni Arjana mill-Punent għal ġol-Indja u l-Arjani ġabu l-lingwa tagħhom magħhom.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Is-Sanskrit hija lingwa antika u tista' titqabbel mal-lingwa Latina mitkellma fl-Ewropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: L-iktar ktieb antik magħruf fid-dinja inkiteb bis-Sanskrit. Wara li ġew ikkumpilati l-Upanishads, is-Sanskrit għeb minħabba l-ġerarkija.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Is-Sanskrit huwa lingwa kumplessa u rikka ħafna, li serviet bħala s-sors għal ħafna lingwi Indjani moderni, l-istess bħalma l-Latin huwa s-sors għal-lingwi Ewropej bħall-Franċiż u l-Ispanjol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Wara li ntemmet il-battalja għal Franza, il-Ġermanja bdiet it-tħejjijiet biex tinvadi l-gżira tal-Gran Brittanja.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Il-Ġermanja użat il-kodiċi “Operation Sealion” (Operazzjoni Iljun tal-Baħar) biex isemmi l-attakk. Ħafna mill-armi tqal u l-provvisti tal-Armata Ingliża kienu ntilfu meta evakwat minn Dunkirk, u minħabba f’hekk l-armata kienet pjuttost dgħajfa.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Iżda l-Flotta Rjali kienet għadha ferm iktar b’saħħitha mill-Flotta Ġermaniża (“Kriegsmarine”) u setgħet qerdet kwalunkwe flotta ta’ invażjoni mibgħuta mill-Kanal Ingliż.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Madankollu, kien hemm verament ftit vapuri tar-Royal Navy li kienu bbażati ħdejn ir-rotot ta’ invażjoni probabbli peress li l-ammirali kienu jibżgħu li jegħrqu minħabba attakk bl-ajru Ġermaniż.
