text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Ejja nibdew bi spjegazzjoni dwar il-pjanijiet tal-Italja. Għall-Ġermanja u l-Ġappun, l-Italja kienet prinċipalment "ħuhom iż-żgħir".
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Kellha armata aktar dgħajfa u flotta aktar dgħajfa, għalkemm kienu għadhom kemm bnew erba’ vapuri ġodda eżatt qabel bdiet il-gwerra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: L-għanijiet ewlenin tal-Italja kienu l-pajjiżi Afrikani. Biex jaqbdu lil dawk il-pajjiżi, huma jkollhom bżonn li jkollhom post minn fejn iniedu t-truppi, sabiex it-truppi jkunu jistgħu jbaħħru madwar il-Baħar Mediterran u jinvadu l-Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Għal dak, kellhom jeħilsu minn bażijiet u vapuri Ingliżi fl-Eġittu. Minbarra dawk l-azzjonijiet, il-vapuri tal-battalja tal-Italja ma kellhom jagħmlu xejn aktar.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Issa għall-Ġappun. Il-Ġappun kien pajjiż gżira, l-istess bħall-Gran Brittanja.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Is-sottomarini huma vapuri ddisinjati biex jivvjaġġaw taħt l-ilma, u jibqgħu hemm għal ammont ta’ żmien estiż.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Is-sottomarini ntużaw fl-Ewwel Gwerra Dinjija u t-Tieni Gwerra Dinjija. Dak iż-żmien kienu jimxu bil-mod ħafna u kellhom firxa ta’ sparar limitata ħafna.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Meta bdiet il-gwerra, huma vvjaġġaw l-aktar fuq il-wiċċ tal-baħar, iżda hekk kif ir-radar beda jiżviluppa u jsir aktar preċiż is-sottomarini ġew sfurzati jidħlu taħt l-ilma biex jevitaw li jidhru.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Is-sottomarini Ġermaniżi kienu jissejħu U-Boats. Il-Ġermaniżi kienu tajbin ħafna biex jinnavigaw u jħaddmu s-sottomarini tagħhom.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Minħabba s-suċċess tagħhom bis-sottomarini, wara l-gwerra, il-Ġermaniżi mhumiex fdati b’ħafna minnhom.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Iva! Ir-Re Tutankhamun, kultant imsejjaħ "Ir-Re Tut" jew "It-Tifel Re", huwa wieħed mir-rejiet tal-Eġittu Antik l-aktar magħrufin fiż-żminijiet moderni.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: B’mod interessanti, hu ma kienx ikkunsidrat importanti ħafna fl-antik u ma kienx irreġistrat fuq il-biċċa l-kbira tal-listi tar-rejiet tal-qedem.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Madankollu, l-iskoperta tal-qabar tiegħu fl-1922 għamlitu ċelebrità. Filwaqt li bosta oqbra tal-passat ġew misruqa, dan il-qabar prattikament ma ġiex disturbat.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Ħafna mill-oġġetti midfuna ma’ Tutankhamun ġew ippreservati sew, inklużi eluf ta’ artefatti magħmulin minn metalli prezzjużi u ħaġar rari.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: L-invenzjoni tar-roti bil-magħżel għamlet il-karrijiet Assirjani eħfef, iktar veloċi, u mħejjija aħjar biex ikunu veloċi iktar mis-suldati u l-karrijiet l-oħra.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Il-vleġeġ mill-qwies li joqtlu tagħhom setgħu jidħlu fl-armatura tas-suldati rivali. Madwar 1000 Q.K, l-Assirjani introduċew l-ewwel kavallerija.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Il-kavallerija hija armata li tiġġieled fuq l-idhra taż-żwiemel. Is-sarġ ma kienx għadu ġie ivvintat, għalhekk il-kavallerija Assirjana ġġieldet fuq l-idhra għerja taż-żwiemel tagħha.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Aħna nafu ħafna politiċi, xjenzati, u artisti Griegi. Probabbilment l-aktar persuna magħrufa ta' din il-kultura hija Omeru, il-poeta agħma leġġendarju, li kkompona żewġ kapolavuri tal-letteratura Griega: il-poeżiji l-Iliad u l-Odissea.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles u Aristophanes għadhom drammaturgi popolari u d-drammi tagħhom huma kkunsidrati bħala fost l-aqwa xogħlijiet tal-letteratura dinjija.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Grieg famuż ieħor huwa l-matematiku Pitagora, l-aktar magħruf għat-teorema famuża tiegħu dwar ir-relazzjonijiet bejn il-ġnub ta' trijangoli retti.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Hemm stimi li jvarjaw dwar kemm hemm nies li jitkellmu bil-Ħindi. Huwa stmat li dan jiġi bejn it-tieni u r-raba' lingwa l-aktar mitkellma fid-dinja.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: In-numru ta’ kelliema nattivi ivarja skont jekk jingħaddux jew le djaletti relatati mill-qrib ħafna.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: L-istimi jvarjaw minn 340 miljun sa 500 miljun kelliema, u massimu sa 800 miljun persuna jistgħu jifhmu l-lingwa.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Il-Ħindi u l-Urdu għandhom vokabularju simili iżda l-iskrittura hija differenti; waqt il-konverżazzjonijiet ta’ kuljum, il-kelliema taż-żewġ lingwi normalment jistgħu jifhmu lil xulxin.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Madwar is-seklu 15, l-Estonja ta’ Fuq kienet taħt influwenza kulturali qawwija mill-Ġermanja.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Xi patrijiet Ġermaniżi riedu jieħdu lil Alla iktar qrib in-nies indiġeni, u għalhekk ivvintaw il-lingwa litterali Estonjana.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Kien ibbażat fuq l-alfabet Ġermaniż u ġie miżjud karattru wieħed "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Mal-mogħdija taż-żmien, ħafna kliem li ġew mislufa mill-Ġermaniż ingħaqdu. Dan kien il-bidu tal-illuminiżmu.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradizzjonalment, il-werriet għat-tron imur dritt fil-militar wara li jispiċċa l-iskola.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Madankollu, Charles mar l-università fi Trinity College, Cambridge fejn studja l-Antropoloġija u l-Arkeoloġija u, iktar tard, l-Istorja, u rċieva 2:2 (lawrija ta’ livell baxx tat-tieni klassi).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles kien l-ewwel membru tal-Familja Rjali Ingliża li ngħata lawrja.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: It-Turkija Ewropea (Thrace tal-Lvant jew Rumelia fil-peniżola tal-Balkani) tinkludi 3 % tal-pajjiż.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: It-territorju tat-Turkija huwa aktar minn 1,600 kilometru (1,000 mil) twil u 800 km (500 mil) wiesa', b'forma bejn wieħed u ieħor rettangolari.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: L-erja tat-Turkija, inklużi l-għadajjar, tokkupa 783,562 kilometru kwadru (300,948 mil kwadru), li minnhom 755,688 kilometru kwadru (291,773 mil kwadru) qegħdin fl-Asja tal-Lbiċ u 23,764 kilometru kwadru (9,174 mil kwadru) fl-Ewropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: L-erja tat-Turkija tagħmilha s-37 waħda fost l-akbar pajjiżi tad-dinja, u hija kważi d-daqs ta' Franza Metropolitana u r-Renju Unit flimkien.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: It-Turkija hija mdawra bl-ibħra fuq tliet naħat: il-Baħar Eġew fil-Punent, il-Baħar l-Iswed fit-Tramuntana u l-Baħar Mediterran fin-Nofsinhar.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Il-Lussemburgu għandu storja twila iżda l-indipendenza tiegħu tibda mill-1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Partijiet tal-Belġju tal-lum il-ġurnata kienu parti mil-Lussemburgu fil-passat iżda saru Belġjani wara r-Rivoluzzjoni Belġjana tas-snin 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Il-Lussemburgu dejjem ipprova jibqa’ pajjiż newtrali iżda kien okkupat kemm fl-Ewwel Gwerra Dinjija kif ukoll fit-Tieni Gwerra Dinjija mill-Ġermanja.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Fl-1957, il-Lussemburgu sar membru fundatur tal-organizzazzjoni li llum hija magħrufa bħala l-Unjoni Ewropea.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong huma fdalijiet ta’ fortizza u monasteru Buddist fil-parti ta’ fuq tad-Distrett ta’ Paro (ġewwa l-Villaġġ ta’ Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Jingħad li fl-1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ħoloq il-fortizza biex jikkommemora r-rebħa tiegħu kontra l-forzi Tibetani-Mongoljani.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Fl-1951, nar kien il-kawża li baqgħu biss uħud mill-fdalijiet tad-Drukgyal Dzong, bħall-immaġni ta’ Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Wara n-nar, il-fortizza kienet ippreservata u mħarsa, u baqgħet biex saret waħda mill-attrazzjonijiet l-aktar sensazzjonali tal-Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Matul is-seklu 18 il-Kambodja sabet ruħha magħfusa bejn żewġ ġirien b’saħħithom, it-Tajlandja u l-Vjetnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: It-Tajlandiżi invadew lill-Kambodja ħafna drabi fis-seklu 18 u fl-1772 qerdu lil Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Fl-aħħar snin tas-seklu 18 il-Vjetnamiżi invadew il-Kambodja wkoll.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Tmintax fil-mija tal-Venezwelani huma qiegħda, u ħafna minn dawk li huma impjegati jaħdmu fl-ekonomija informali.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Żewġ terzi tal-Venezwelani li jaħdmu jagħmlu hekk fis-settur tas-servizzi, kważi kwart jaħdmu fl-industrija u wieħed minn ħamsa jaħdem fl-agrikoltura.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Industrija importanti għal-Venezwelani hija dik taż-żejt, fejn il-pajjiż huwa esportatur nett, minkejja li wieħed fil-mija biss jaħdem fl-industrija taż-żejt.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Fil-bidu tal-indipendenza tan-nazzjon, l-għarfien espert tal-Ġonna Botaniċi ta’ Singapore għen biex jittrasforma l-gżira f’Belt Ġnien tropikali.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Fis-sena 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, ibrida orkidea, intgħażlet bħala l-fjura nazzjonali tan-nazzjon.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Kull sena lejn Ottubru kważi 1.5 miljun erbivori jivvjaġġaw lejn il-pjanuri tan-Nofsinhar, jaqsmu x-Xmara Mara, mill-għoljiet tat-Tramuntana għax-xita.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: U mbagħad lura lejn it-Tramuntana minn ġol-Punent, u għal darb'oħra tinqasam ix-xmara Mara, wara x-xita li tinżel għal ħabta ta' April.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Ir-reġjun tas-Serengeti fih il-Park Nazzjonali tas-Serengeti, iż-Żona ta' Konservazzjoni ta' Ngorongoro u r-Riserva tal-Kaċċa ta' Maswa fit-Tanżanija u r-Riserva Nazzjonali tal-Mara tal-Maasai fil-Kenja.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: It-tagħlim biex tinħoloq midja interattiva jeħtieġ ħiliet konvenzjonali u tradizzjonali, kif ukoll għodda magħrufin sewwa fi klassijiet interattivi (ippjanar ta’ stejjer, editjar tal-awdjo u l-vidjow, rakkontar ta’ stejjer, eċċ.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Id-disinn interattiv jeħtieġ li inti terġa’ tivvaluta s-suppożizzjonijiet tiegħek dwar il-produzzjoni tal-midja u titgħallem taħseb b’modi mhux lineari.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Id-disinn interattiv jeħtieġ li l-komponenti ta’ proġett jikkonnettjaw flimkien, imma jridu jagħmlu sens bħala entità separata wkoll.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: L-iżvantaġġ tal-lentijiet taż-żum huwa li l-kumplessità fokali u n-numru ta’ elementi tal-lenti meħtieġa biex tinkiseb firxa ta’ tulijiet fokali hija ħafna ikbar milli għal lentijiet fissi.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Din qed issir inqas problema minħabba li l-manifatturi tal-lentijiet qed jiksbu standards ogħla fil-produzzjoni tal-lentijiet.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Dan ippermetta li l-lentijiet żum jipprovdu stampi ta' kwalità paragunabbli ma' dik miksuba mil-lentijiet bit-tul fokali fiss.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Żvantaġġ ieħor tal-lentijiet żum huwa li l-apertura massima (il-veloċità) tal-lenti ġeneralment tkun aktar baxxa.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Minħabba dan huwa diffiċli biex lentijiet żum irħas jintużaw f'kundizzjonijiet ta' dawl baxx mingħajr flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Waħda mill-iktar problemi komuni meta tipprova taqleb film għal format DVD hija l-“overscan”.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Ħafna televiżjonijiet isiru b’tali mod li l-pubbliku ġenerali jogħġbuh.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Għal dik ir-raġuni, dak kollu li tara fuq it-TV kellu l-borduri maqtugħin, minn fuq, isfel u l-ġnub.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Dan isir biex jiġi żgurat li l-immaġni tkopri l-iskrin kollu. Dik tissejjaħ overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Sfortunatament, meta tagħmel DVD, il-burduri tagħha probabbilment jinqatgħu ukoll, u jekk il-vidjow kellu s-sottotitoli qrib wisq tal-qiegħ, ma jiġux murija kompletament.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Il-kastell medjevali tradizzjonali ilu jispira l-immaġinazzjoni, u jikkonġura immaġnijiet ta' jousts, pranzijiet u l-kavallerat Arturjan.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Anke wieqaf f’nofs fdalijiet li għandhom elf sena, faċli li wieħed jiftakar il-ħsejjes u l-irwejjaħ ta’ battalji li ilhom li għaddew, li kważi tisma’ ċ-ċekċik tan-nagħal fuq iċ-ċangaturi u xxomm il-biża’ tiela’ mill-fosos ta’ taħt l-art.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Imma l-immaġinazzjoni tagħna hija bbażata fuq ir-realtà? Imma, qabel xejn, għal liema raġuni nbnew il-kastelli? Kif ġew iddisinjati u mibnija?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipiku għall-perjodu, il-Kastell Kirby Muxloe aktar qisu dar iffortifikata milli kastell veru.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: It-twieqi kbar igglejżjati u l-ħitan irqaq tiegħu ma setgħux jirreżistu attakk determinat fit-tul.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Fis-snin 1480, meta l-kostruzzjoni tiegħu ġie mibdija minn Lord Hastings, il-pajjiż kien relattivament paċifiku u d-difiża kienet meħtieġa biss kontra faxex żgħar ta’ rejders li jduru.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Il-bilanċ tal-poter kienet sistema li fiha n-nazzjonijiet Ewropej ippruvaw iżommu s-sovranità nazzjonali tal-istati Ewropej kollha.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Il-kunċett kien li n-nazzjonijiet Ewropej kollha kellhom ifittxu li jimpedixxu lil nazzjon wieħed milli jsir b’saħħtu u, għalhekk, il-gvernijiet nazzjonali ħafna drabi bidlu l-alleanzi tagħhom sabiex jinżamm il-bilanċ.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Il-Gwerra tas-Suċċessjoni Spanjola mmarkat l-ewwel gwerra li l-kwistjoni ċentrali tagħha kienet il-bilanċ tal-poter.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Dan immarka bidla importanti, minħabba li l-potenzi Ewropej ma setax ikollhom aktar l-iskuża li jkunu gwerer reliġjużi. Għalhekk, il-Gwerra ta' Tletin Sena tiġi l-aħħar gwerra bit-tikketta ta' gwerra reliġjuża.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: It-tempju ta' Artemis f'Efesu nqered fil-21 ta' Lulju tat-356 QEK f'att ta' ħruq imwettaq minn Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Skont l-istorja, il-motivazzjoni tiegħu kienet li jikseb il-fama akkost ta' kollox. L-Efesjani, irrabjati ħafna, ħabbru li isem Herostratus ma jiġi rrekordjat qatt.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: L-istoriku Grieg Strabo iktar tard ħa nota tal-isem, li huwa kif nafu llum. It-tempju nqered fl-istess lejl li twieled Alessandru l-Kbir.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alessandru, bħala r-re, offra li jħallas għall-bini mill-ġdid tat-tempju, imma l-offerta tiegħu ġiet miċħuda. Aktar tard, it-tempju nbena mill-ġdid fit-323 QEK.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Kun żgur li jdejk tkun rilassata kemm jista’ jkun waqt li xorta tolqot in-noti kollha b’mod korrett - ipprova wkoll tagħmilx ħafna moviment estranju b’subgħajk.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: B'dan il-mod, se tgħejja lilek innifsek l-inqas possibbli. Ftakar li m'hemmx bżonn li tolqot it-tasti b'forza kbira għal aktar volum bħal fuq il-pjanu.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Fuq l-accordion, biex tikseb iktar volum, tuża l-minfaħ b’iktar pressjoni jew veloċità.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Il-mistiċiżmu huwa l-insegwiment ta’ komunjoni, identità, jew għarfien konxju ta’ realtà aħħarija, divinità, verità spiritwali, jew Alla.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Dawk li jemmnu jfittxu esperjenza diretta, intwizzjoni, jew għarfien dwar ir-realtà divina/l-alla jew l-allat.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Is-segwaċi japplikaw ċerti modi ta’ kif jgħixu, jew prattiki li huma maħsuba biex irawmu dawk l-esperjenzi.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Il-mistiċiżmu jista’ jiġi distint minn għamliet oħra ta’ twemmin u qima reliġjużi b'enfasi fuq l-esperjenza personali diretta ta’ stat ta’ kuxjenza uniku, partikolarment dawk ta’ karattru paċifiku, intuwittiv, hieni, jew saħansitra estatiku.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Is-Sikiżmu hija reliġjon li ġejja mis-subkontinent Indjan. Din oriġinat fir-reġjun tal-Punjab tul is-seklu 15 minn qasma settarja fit-tradizzjoni Ħindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Is-Sikh jikkunsidraw il-fidi tagħhom bħala reliġjon separata mill-Induiżmu għalkemm jirrikonoxxu l-għeruq u t-tradizzjonijiet mill-Indu tagħha.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Is-Sikhs isejħu r-reliġjon tagħhom Gurmat, li hija Punġabi għal "it-tagħlim tal-guru". Il-guru huwa aspett fundamentali tar-reliġjonijiet Indjani kollha iżda fis-Sikiżmu ħa importanza li tifforma l-qalba tat-twemmin Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Ir-reliġjon ġie stabbilit fis-seklu 15 minn Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Wara ġew disa' gurus oħra wara xulxin.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Madankollu, f’Ġunju  1956, il-wegħdiet ta’ Krushchev ġew ittestjati meta rewwixti fil-Polonja, fejn il-ħaddiema kienu qed jipprotestaw kontra nuqqas ta’ ikel u tnaqqis fi-pagi, inbidlu fi protesti ġenerali kontra l-Komuniżmu.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Għalkemm fl-aħħar, Krushchev bagħat it-tankijiet biex jerġgħu jistabbilixxu l-ordni, huwa fil-fatt ċeda għal xi talbiet ekonomiċi u aċċetta li jaħtar lil Wladyslaw Gomulka, li kien popolari, bħala l-prim ministru l-ġdid.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Iċ-Ċivilizzazzjoni tal-Wied tal-Indus kienet ċivilizzazzjoni tal-Età tal-Bronż fil-Majjistral tas-subkontinent Indjan li kienet tinkludi ħafna mill-Pakistan modern u xi reġjuni fil-Majjistral tal-Indja u l-Grigal tal-Afganistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Iċ-ċiviltà iffjorixxiet fil-baċiri tax-Xmara Indus minn fejn tieħu isimha.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Għalkemm xi studjużi jispekulaw li minħabba li ċ-ċiviltà eżistiet ukoll fil-baċiri tax-Xmara Sarasvati li issa nixfet, b'mod xieraq għandha tissejjaħ iċ-Ċiviltà Indus-Sarasvati, waqt li xi wħud isejħulha ċ-Ċiviltà ta' Ħarappa għal Ħarappa, l-ewwel wieħed mis-siti tagħha li ġie skavat fis-snin 20 tas-seklu għoxrin.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: In-natura militaristika tal-imperu Ruman għenet fl-iżvilupp ta’ avvanzi mediċi.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: It-tobba bdew jiġu reklutati mill-Imperatur Awgustu u saħansitra ffurmaw l-ewwel Korp Mediku Ruman għal użu fil-konsegwenzi tal-battalji.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Il-kirurgi kellhom għarfien dwar sedattivi varji inkluża morfina minn estratti taż-żerriegħa tal-peprin u skopolamina minn żrieragħ tal-herbane.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Huma saru profiċjenti fl-amputazzjoni biex isalvaw il-pazjenti mill-kankrena kif ukoll it-turniketti u l-klampi arterjali biex iwaqqfu l-fluss tad-demm.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Matul bosta sekli, l-imperu Ruman wassal għal kisbiet kbar fil-qasam tal-mediċina u fforma ħafna mill-għarfien li nafu llum.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L-origami Pureland huwa origami bir-restrizzjoni li tista’ ssir tinja darba biss kull darba, tinjiet iktar kumplessi bħal tinjiet b’lura mhumiex permessi, u t-tinjiet kollha għandhom postijiet sempliċi.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Ġie żviluppat minn John Smith fis-sebgħinijiet biex jgħin lil dawk li jitwu mingħajr esperjenza jew dawk b’ħiliet motorili limitati.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: It-tfal jiżviluppaw sensibilizzazzjoni rigward ir-razza u l-isterjotipi razzjali minn meta jkunu pjuttost żgħar u dawn l-isterjotipi razzjali jaffettwaw l-aġir tagħhom.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Pereżempju, tfal li jidentifikaw ruħhom bħala parti minn minoranza razzjali li hija sterjotipata bħala li mhix tajba fl-iskola għandhom tendenza li ma jkunux tajbin fl-iskola meta jiskopru l-isterjotip assoċjat mar-razza tagħhom.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace huwa t-tielet l-iktar sit web popolari użata fl-Istati Uniti u għandu 54 miljun profil bħalissa.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Dawn is-siti web ingħataw ħafna attenzjoni, speċjalment fl-ambjent edukattiv.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Hemm aspetti pożittivi għal dawn is-siti web, li jinkludu li tkun tista' faċilment toħloq paġna tal-klassi li tista' tinkludi blogs, vidjows, ritratti, u karatteristiċi oħra.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Din il-paġna tista' tiġi aċċessata faċilment billi tipprovdi indirizz web wieħed biss, li jagħmilha faċli biex jiftakruh u faċli biex jittajpjawh għal studenti li jista' jkollhom problemi biex jużaw il-keyboard jew biex jispellu.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Jista’ jkun personalizzat biex jagħmilha faċli biex taqrah kif ukoll b’ammont ta’ kulur li tixtieq.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Id-Disturb ta’ Defiċit tal-Attenzjoni "huwa sindromu newroloġiku li t-tliet sintomi klassiċi tiegħu jinkludu impulsività, distrazzjoni, u iperattività jew eċċess ta’ enerġija".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Mhix diżabilità fit-tagħlim, hija disturb fit-tagħlim; din "taffettwa 3 sa 5 fil-mija tat-tfal kollha, forsi daqs 2 miljun tifel u tifla Amerikani".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: It-tfal bl-ADD isibuha diffiċli li jiffokaw fuq affarijiet bħax-xogħol tal-iskola, iżda jistgħu jikkonċentraw fuq affarijiet li jħobbu jagħmlu bħal jilagħbu jew jaraw il-cartoons favoriti tagħhom jew jiktbu sentenzi mingħajr punteġġjatura.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Dawn it-tfal għandhom it-tendenza li jidħlu f'ħafna inkwiet, għax huma "jwettqu mġiba riskjuża, jiġġieldu, u jisfidaw l-awtorità" sabiex jistimulaw moħħhom, peress li moħħhom ma jistax jiġi stimulat b'metodi normali.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L-ADD taffettwa r-relazzjonijiet mat-tfal tal-istess età għax it-tfal l-oħra ma jistgħux jifhmu għaliex huma jaġixxu b'dak il-mod jew għaliex huma jispellu b'dak il-mod jew li l-livell tal-maturità tagħhom huwa differenti.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Meta l-abbiltà li jinkiseb għarfien u tagħlim inbidel bil-mod imsemmi hawn fuq, ir-rata bażi li biha nkiseb għarfien inbidlet ukoll.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: L-approċċ għall-kisba ta' informazzjoni kien differenti. Ma kienx baqa’ pressjoni fuq il-ftakir individwali imma, pjuttost, saret enfasi fuq il-kapaċità tal-ftakir tat-test.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Essenzjalment, ir-Rinaxximent għamel bidla sinifikanti fl-approċċ għat-tagħlim u t-tixrid tal-għarfien.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: B'kuntrast ma' primati oħra, il-ħominidi m'għadhomx jużaw idejhom fil-lokomozzjoni jew biex iġorru piż jew jitbandlu fost is-siġar.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: L-id u s-sieq tax-ximpanżì huma simili fid-daqs u t-tul, li jirrifletti l-użu tal-id biex iġorr il-piż waqt il-mixi fuq l-għekiesi tas-swaba'.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: L-id tal-bniedem hija iqsar mis-sieq, b’falanġi iktar dritti.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Fossili tal-għadam tal-idejn li għandhom żewġ miljun sa tliet miljun sena juru din il-bidla fl-ispeċjalizzazzjoni tal-idejn minn lokomozzjoni għal manipulazzjoni.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Xi nies jemmnu li jekk tesperjenza ħafna ħolm luċidu kkaġunat artifiċjalment spiss biżżejjed jista’ jkun eżawrjenti ħafna.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Ir-raġuni ewlenija għal dan il-fenomenu huwa r-riżultat tal-ħolm luċidu li jespandi t-tul ta’ żmien bejn l-istati REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: B'inqas perjodi fl-irqad meta jkun hemm ċaqliq rapidu tal-għajnejn (REMs), dan l-istat li fih tesperjenza l-irqad vera u l-ġisem tiegħek jirkupra jsir inqas frekwenti tant li jiżviluppa fi problema.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Dan huwa eżawrjenti daqs li kieku kellek tqum kull għoxrin jew tletin minuta u tara t-televixin.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L-effett jiddependi fuq kemm-il darba moħħok jipprova joħlom luċidu kull lejl.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: L-affarijiet ma marrux tajjeb għat-Taljani fl-Afrika ta' Fuq kważi mill-bidu. Fi żmien ġimgħa mid-dikjarazzjoni tal-gwerra tal-Italja, fl-10 ta' Ġunju tal-1940, l-11th Hussars Brittaniċi kienu ħatfu l-Fortizza Capuzzo fil-Libja.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: F’imbuska ġewwa l-Lvant ta’ Bardia, l-Ingliżi kkatturaw lill-Kap Inġinier tal-Għaxar Armata Taljana, il-Ġeneral Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Fit-28 ta’ Ġunju, il-Marixxall Italo Balbo, il-Gvernatur Ġenerali tal-Libja u eredi apparenti ta’ Mussolini, inqatel permezz ta’ sparar mhux ostili (“friendly fire”) waqt li kien niżel f’Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: L-isport modern tal-iżgirma jintlagħab f’ħafna livelli, minn studenti li jistudjaw f’università għal kompetizzjoni professjonali u Olimpika.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: L-isport primarjament jintlagħab bħala dwell, fejn fenser jiddwella ma' fenser ieħor.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Il-golf hija logħba fejn il-plejers jużaw klabbs biex jitfgħu l-blalen fit-toqob.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Waqt rawnd regolari jintlagħbu tmintax-il toqba, fejn il-plejers ġeneralment jibdew mill-ewwel toqba fil-korsa u jispiċċaw bit-tmintax-il waħda.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Il-plejer li jagħmel l-inqas numru ta' daqqiet, jew tixjir tal-istikka, biex ilesti l-korsa jirbaħ.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Il-logħba tintlagħab fuq il-ħaxix, u l-ħaxix madwar it-toqba jiġi maqtugħ iqsar u jissejjaħ l-aħdar (“the green”).
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Forsi l-iktar tip ta’ turiżmu komuni huwa dak li ħafna nies jassoċjawh mal-ivvjaġġar: It-turiżmu ta’ rikreazzjoni.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Dan huwa meta n-nies imorru f'post li huwa differenti ħafna mill-ħajja regolari ta' kuljum tagħhom biex jistrieħu u jieħdu pjaċir.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Ħafna drabi, il-bajjiet, il-parks tematiċi u l-postijiet fejn isiru l-kampijiet huma l-aktar postijiet komunement iffrekwentati minn turisti rikreazzjonali.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Jekk l-għan taż-żjara ta’ xi ħadd f’post partikolari huwa li jsir taf l-istorja u l-kultura tiegħu, dan it-tip ta’ turiżmu huwa magħruf bħala turiżmu kulturali.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: It-turisti jistgħu jżuru l-attrazzjonijiet differenti ta' pajjiż partikulari jew jistgħu sempliċement jagħżlu li jiffokaw fuq żona waħda biss.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Meta raw din l-attività, il-Kolonisti kienu rrikjedew li jintbagħtulhom rinforzi wkoll.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: It-truppi li saħħu l-pożizzjonijiet ta' quddiem kienu jinkludu r-riġmenti tal-1el u 3et New Hampshire b'200 suldat, taħt il-Kurunelli John Stark u James Reed (li t-tnejn aktar tard saru ġenerali).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: L-irġiel ta’ Stark ħadu pożizzjonijiet tul iċ-ċint fit-tarf tat-Tramuntana tal-pożizzjoni tal-Kolonista.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Meta l-frugħ tal-baħar fetaħ vojt tul ix-Xmara Mystic matul il-Grigal tal-peniżola, huma malajr estendew iċ-ċint b'ħajt qasir tal-ġebel lejn it-Tramuntana li ntemm fix-xifer tal-ilma fuq xatt ramli żgħir.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley jew Stark poġġew zokk ta’ madwar 100 pied (30 m) quddiem ix-xatba u ordnaw li ħadd ma jispara qabel jgħaddu r-regolari.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Il-pjan Amerikan kien jiddependi fuq it-tnedija ta’ attakki kkoordinati minn tliet direzzjonijiet differenti.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Il-Ġeneral John Cadwalder nieda attakk ta’ devjazzjoni kontra l-gwarniġġjon Ingliż ġewwa Bordentown, sabiex jimblokka kwalunkwe rinforzi.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Il-Ġeneral James Ewing ħa 700 milizzja u qasmu x-xmara fi Trenton Ferry, ħatfu l-pont fuq Assunpink Creek u impedixxew lit-truppi tal-għadu milli jaħarbu.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Il-forza ewlenija tal-attakk ta’ 2,400 raġel qasmet ix-xmara disa’ mili fit-Tramuntana ta’ Trenton, u mbagħad inqasmet f’żewġ gruppi, wieħed taħt Greene u wieħed taħt Sullivan, sabiex jiġi mniedi attakk qabel is-sebħ.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Bil-bidla mill-ġirja ta' kwart ta' mil għal dik ta' nofs mil, il-veloċità ssir inqas importanti u l-kapaċità li wieħed jirreżisti ssir meħtieġa b'mod assolut.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Naturalment ġerrej tan-nofs mil tal-ewwel klassi, bniedem li jista’ jagħmilha f’żewġ minuti, irid jkollu ammont ta’ veloċità tajba, imma r-reżistenza trid tkun ikkultivata fil-perikli kollha.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Xi tlielaq bejn il-pajjiżi fix-xitwa, flimkien ma’ xogħol fil-ġinnażju għall-parti ta’ fuq tal-ġisem, hija l-aħjar preparazzjoni għall-istaġun tal-ġiri.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Prattiċi nutrittivi korretti waħedhom ma jistgħux jiġġeneraw prestazzjonijiet elit, iżda jistgħu jaffettwaw il-benessri ġenerali tal-atleti żgħażagħ b’mod sinifikanti.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Iż-żamma ta’ bilanċ tajjeb ta’ enerġija, il-prattika ta’ drawwiet effettivi ta’ idratazzjoni, u l-fehim tad-diversi aspetti tal-prattiki ta’ supplimentazzjoni jistgħu jgħinu lill-atleti jtejbu l-prestazzjoni tagħhom u jżidu t-tgawdija tagħhom tal-isport.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Il-ġiri fid-distanza medja huwa sport relattivament irħis; madankollu, hemm ħafna kunċetti żbaljati rigward il-ftit biċċiet ta’ tagħmir meħtieġa biex tipparteċipa.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Il-prodotti jistgħu jinxtraw skont il-bżonn, imma l-maġġor parti se jkollhom ftit jew xejn impatt reali fuq il-prestazzjoni.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: L-atleti jistgħu jħossu li jippreferu prodott anke jekk ma jipprovdi ebda benefiċċji reali.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L-atomu jista’ jitqies bħala wieħed mill-elementi fundamentali għall-bini tal-materja kollha.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Hija entità kumplessa ħafna li tikkonsisti, skont mudell simplifikat ta’ Bohr, f’nukleu ċentrali orbitat minn elettroni, kemmxejn simili għal pjaneti li jduru madwar ix-xemx - ara l-Figura 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: In-nukleu jikkonsisti f’żewġ partiċelli - newtroni u protoni.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Il-protoni għandhom ċarġ elettriku pożittiv filwaqt li n-newtroni m’għandhom l-ebda ċarġ. L-elettroni għandhom ċarġ elettriku negattiv.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Biex tiċċekkja l-vittma, l-ewwel trid tistħarreġ il-post biex tiżgura s-sikurezza tiegħek.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Trid tinnota l-pożizzjoni tal-vittma meta tersaq lejh jew lejha u awtomatikament tqis kwalunkwe sinjal ta' periklu.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Jekk tweġġa’ waqt li tkun qed tipprova tgħin, tista’ sservi biss biex tagħmel l-affarijiet agħar.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: L-istudju sab li d-dipressjoni, il-biża' u l-katastrofiżmu intermedjaw ir-relazzjoni bejn l-uġigħ u d-diżabilità f'dawk li jbatu minn uġigħ fil-parti t'isfel tad-dahar.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: L-effetti ta’ katastrofizzazzjoni biss, u mhux ta’ depressjoni u biża’, kienu jiddependu fuq sessjonijiet ta’ PA strutturati regolarment ta’ kull ġimgħa.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Dawk li jipparteċipaw f'attività regolari jeħtieġu aktar appoġġ fir-rigward tal-perċezzjoni negattiva tal-uġigħ li tiddistingwi d-differenzi ta' uġigħ kroniku u sensazzjoni ta' skumdità minn moviment fiżiku normali.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Il-vista, jew l-abilità li tara tiddependi fuq l-organi sensorjali tas-sistema viżwali jew l-għajnejn.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Jeżistu bosta kostruzzjonijiet differenti tal-għajnejn, li jvarjaw fil-kumplessità skont il-bżonnijiet tal-organiżmu.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Il-kostruzzjonijiet differenti għandhom kapaċitajiet differenti, huma sensittivi għal tulijiet ta’ mewġ differenti u għandhom gradi differenti ta’ akutezza, u jeħtieġu wkoll ipproċessar differenti biex jagħmlu sens tal-inpu u numri differenti biex jaħdmu bl-aħjar mod.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Popolazzjoni hija kollezzjoni ta' organiżmi ta' speċi partikulari ġo żona ġeografika speċifika.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Meta l-individwi kollha f'popolazzjoni huma identiċi fir-rigward ta' karatteristika fenotipika particulari huma jkunu magħrufin bħala monomorfiċi.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Meta l-individwi juru bosta varjanti ta' karatteristika speċifika, ikunu polimorfiċi.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Il-kolonji tal-armati tan-nemel jimmarċjaw u jbejtu fi stadji differenti wkoll.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Fil-fażi nomadika, in-nemel tal-armata jimmarċjaw bil-lejl u jieqfu biex jikkampjaw tul il-ġurnata.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Il-kolonja tibda fażi nomadika meta l-ikel disponibbli jkun naqas. Matul din il-fażi, il-kolonja tagħmel bejtiet temporanji li jinbidlu kuljum.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Kull waħda minn dawn ir-rewwixti jew marċi nomadiċi ddum madwar 17-il jum.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: X'inhi ċellula? Il-kelma ċellula ġejja mill-kelma Latina "cella", li tfisser "kamra żgħira", u kienet użata l-ewwel darba minn mikroskopista qed josserva l-istruttura tas-sufra.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Iċ-ċellula hija l-unità bażika tal-kreaturi kollha, u l-organiżmi kollha huma komposti minn ċellula waħda jew iktar.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Iċ-ċelloli tant huma bażiċi u kritiċi għall-istudju tal-ħajja li, fil-fatt, spiss jissejħu "l-unitajiet bażiċi li fuqhom tinbena l-ħajja".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Is-Sistema Nervuża żżomm l-omeostasi billi tibgħat impulsi tan-nervituri mal-ġisem kollu biex iżżomm il-fluss tad-demm għaddej kif ukoll mhux disturbat.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Dawn l-impulsi tan-nervituri jistgħu jintbagħtu tant malajr madwar il-ġisem li jgħinu biex iżommu l-ġisem sikur minn kwalunkwe theddida potenzjali.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: It-tornadoes jolqtu żona żgħira kkomparata mal-maltempati vjolenti l-oħrajn, imma jistgħu jeqirdu kull ma jkun hemm fi triqthom.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: It-trombi tal-arja jaqilgħu s-siġar, iċarrtu t-twavel mill-bini, u jgħollu l-karozzi 'l fuq fis-sema. L-iktar tnejn fil-mija tat-trombi tal-arja vjolenti jdumu iktar minn tliet sigħat.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Dawn il-maltempati mostrużi għandhom irwiefen sa 480 km/siegħa (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Il-bnedmin ilhom jagħmlu u jużaw lentijiet għall-ingrandiment għal eluf u eluf ta’ snin.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Madankollu, l-ewwel teleskopji veri saru fl-Ewropa fl-aħħar tas-seklu 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Dawn it-teleskopji użaw kombinazzjoni ta' żewġ lentijiet biex oġġetti 'l bogħod jiġu jidhru aktar qrib u akbar.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ir-regħba u l-egoiżmu dejjem se jkunu jeżistu u, fin-natura inerenti tal-kooperazzjoni, meta l-maġġoranza jibbenefikaw dejjem se ikun hemm aktar x'jinkiseb fi żmien qasir billi taġixxi b’mod egoist.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Nisperaw li ħafna nies jindunaw li l-aħjar għażla fit-tul tagħhom hija li jaħdmu flimkien mal-oħrajn.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Ħafna nies joħolmu bil-jum meta l-bnedmin ikunu jistgħu jivvjaġġaw lejn stilla oħra u jesploraw dinjiet oħra, xi nies jistaqsu x’hemm hemm barra, xi wħud jemmnu li jistgħu jgħixu aljeni jew ħajja oħra fuq pjaneta oħra.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Iżda, jekk dan qatt jiġri probabbilment ma jdumx għaddej żmien twil. L-istilel huma mifruxa b’tali mod li hemm triljuni ta’ mili bejn l-stilel li huma "ġirien".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Forsi xi darba, it-tfal tat-tfal tat-tfal tiegħek se jkunu bilwieqfa fuq dinja aljena u jistaqsu dwar l-antenati antiki tagħhom?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: L-annimali huma magħmulin minn ħafna ċelluli. Huma jieklu l-affarijiet u jiddiġerixxuhom ġewwa fihom. Il-maġġoranza tal-annimali jistgħu jiċċaqalqu.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: L-annimali biss għandhom imħuħ (għalkemm mhux l-annimali kollha għandhom; pereżempju, il-bram m’għandhomx moħħ).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: L-annimali jinstabu madwar id-dinja kollha. Huma jħaffru fl-art, jgħumu fl-oċeani, u jtiru fis-sema.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Ċellola hija l-iżgħar unità strutturali u funzjonali ta' organiżmu (ħaġa ħajja).
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Il-kelma “ċellola” ġejja mill-kelma Latina “cella” li tfisser kamra żgħira.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Jekk tħares lejn l-affarijiet ħajjin taħt mikroskopju, tara li dawn huma magħmulin minn kwadri jew blalen żgħar.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, bijologu mill-Ingilterra, ra kaxex żgħar fis-sufra taħt mikroskopju.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Huma dehru qishom kmamar. Huwa kien l-ewwel persuna li osservat iċ-ċelluli mejtin
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: L-elementi u l-komposti jistgħu jiċċaqalqu minn stat għal ieħor u ma jinbidlux.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: In-nitroġenu bħala gass xorta għandu l-istess proprjetajiet bħan-nitroġenu likwidu. L-istat likwidu huwa iktar dens iżda l-molekuli jibqgħu l-istess.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L-ilma huwa eżempju ieħor. L-ilma kompost huwa magħmul minn żewġ atomi tal-idroġenu u atomu wieħed tal-ossiġenu.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Dan għandu l-istess struttura molekulari indipendenti minn jekk huwiex gass, likwidu, jew solidu.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Għalkemm l-istat fiżiku tiegħu jista' jinbidel, l-istat kimiku tiegħu jibqa' l-istess.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Iż-żmien huwa xi ħaġa li hija madwarna, u jaffettwa kull ma nagħmlu, iżda huwa diffiċli li nifhmuh.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Iż-żmien ġie studajt minn skolari reliġjużi, filosofiċi, u xjentifiċi għal eluf ta' snin.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Aħna nesperjenzaw il-ħin bħala serje ta' avvenimenti għaddejjin mill-futur għal ġol-preżent għall-passat.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Iż-żmien huwa wkoll kif inqabblu d-durata (it-tul) tal-avvenimenti.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Tista' timmarka l-mogħdija taż-żmien inti stess billi tosserva r-ripetizzjoni ta' avveniment ċikliku. Avveniment ċikliku huwa xi ħaġa li sseħħ ripetutament b'mod regolari.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Il-kompjuters illum jintużaw biex jimmanipulaw stampi u vidjows.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animazzjonijiet sofistikati jistgħu jinbnew fuq il-kompjuters, u din it-tip ta’ animazzjoni qed jintuża dejjem iktar fit-televiżjoni u fil-films.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Il-mużika spiss tiġi rrekordjata permezz ta’ kompjuters sofistikati li jipproċessaw u jikkombinaw il-ħsejjes flimkien.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Għal ħafna żmien tul is-sekli dsatax u għoxrin, kien maħsub li l-ewwel abitanti ta’ New Zealand kienu l-poplu tal-Maori, li kienu jikkaċċjaw għasafar enormi li jissejħu “moas”.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: It-teorija mbagħad stabbiliet l-idea li l-poplu Maori emigra mill-Polineżja fi Flotta Kbira u ħa New Zealand mingħand il-Moriori, u stabbilixxa soċjetà agrikola.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Madankollu, evidenza ġdida tissuġġerixxi li l-Moriori kienu grupp ta’ Maori kontinentali li emigraw minn New Zealand għall-Gżejjer Chatham, u żviluppaw il-kultura paċifika u distintiva tagħhom stess.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Kien hemm ukoll tribù ieħor fil-gżejjer Chatham u dawn kienu l-Maori li emigraw minn New Zealand.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Huma kienu jsejħu lilhom infushom il-Moriori, kien hemm xi ftit ġlidiet u fl-aħħar, il-Moriori ġew meqruda.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Individwi li kienu ilhom involuti għal ħafna deċennji għenuna napprezzaw il-punti pożittivi u l-passjonijiet tagħna waqt li nevalwaw id-diffikultajiet u anke l-fallimenti b'mod ċar.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Waqt li konna qed nisimgħu lill-individwi jikkondividu l-istejjer individwali, familjari u organizzazzjonali tagħhom, ksibna għarfien prezzjuż dwar il-passat u xi wħud mill-personalitajiet li influwenzaw għat-tajjeb jew ħażin il-kultura tal-organizzazzjoni.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Waqt li l-fehim tal-istorja tal-persuna ma jassumix li wieħed jifhem il-kultura, għall-inqas dan jgħin lin-nies biex jiksbu sens ta' fejn jinsabu fi ħdan l-istorja tal-organizzazzjoni.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Waqt li jivvalutaw is-suċċessi u jsiru konxji tal-fallimenti, l-individwi u l-persuni parteċipanti kollha jiskopru b'mod aktar profond il-valuri, il-missjoni, u l-forzi li jmexxu l-organizzazzjoni.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: F’dan il-każ, it-tfakkir ta’ każijiet preċedenti ta’ mġieba intraprenditorjali u s-suċċessi li rriżultaw għenu lin-nies ikunu miftuħa għal bidliet ġodda u direzzjoni ġdida għall-knisja lokali.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Stejjer ta’ suċċess bħal dawn naqqsu l-biżgħat tal-bidla, filwaqt li ħolqu inklinazzjonijiet pożittivi lejn il-bidla fil-futur.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Tendenzi ta’ ħsibijiet konverġenti huma tekniki ta’ soluzzjoni ta’ problemi li jgħaqqdu ideat jew oqsma differenti flimkien sabiex tinstab soluzzjoni.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: L-enfasi ta’ din il-mentalità hija l-veloċità, il-loġika u l-preċiżjoni, kif ukoll l-identifikazzjoni tal-fatti, l-applikazzjoni mill-ġdid ta’ tekniki eżistenti, il-ġbir ta’ informazzjoni.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: L-iktar fattur importanti f’din il-mentalità huwa li: hemm risposta tajba waħda biss. Tista’ taħseb biss f’żewġ risposti, jiġifieri t-tajba jew il-ħażina.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Dan it-tip ta' ħsieb huwa assoċjat ma' ċerti proċeduri standard jew tax-xjenza.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Nies b’dan it-tip ta’ raġunament għandhom raġunament loġiku, huma kapaċi jimmemorizzaw mudelli, isolvu problemi u jaħdmu fuq testijiet xjentifiċi.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Il-bnedmin huma bil-kbir l-iktar speċi b’talent biex jaqra moħħ ħaddieħor.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Dak ifisser li nkunu nistgħu nipprevedu b’suċċess dak li jipperċepixxu nies oħra, dak li beħsiebhom jagħmlu, dak li jemmnu, jafu jew jixtiequ.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Fost dawn l-abbiltajiet, il-fehim tal-intenzjoni tal-oħrajn huwa kruċjali. Huwa jippermettilna li nirriżolvu l-ambigwitajiet potenzjali tal-azzjonijiet fiżiċi.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Pereżempju, kieku kellek tara lil xi ħadd ikisser tieqa ta’ karozza, probabbilment tassumi li kien qed jipprova jisraq karozza ta’ xi ħadd li ma jafx.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Huwa jkun meħtieġ li jiġi ġġudikat b’mod differenti kieku tilef iċ-ċwievet tal-karozza tiegħu u l-karozza li kien qed jipprova jidħol fiha kienet tiegħu stess.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: L-MRI hija bbażata fuq fenomenu tal-fiżika msejjaħ reżonanza manjetika nukleari (nuclear magnetic resonance - NMR), li ġiet skoperta fis-snin tletin minn Felix Bloch (li jaħdem fl-Università ta’ Stanford) u Edward Purcell (mill-Università ta’ Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: F’din ir-reżonanza, il-kamp manjetiku u l-mewġ tar-radju jikkawżaw lill-atomi jagħtu sinjali tar-radju żgħar.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Fis-sena 1970, Raymond Damadian, tabib u xjenzat tar-riċerka, skopra l-bażi għall-użu tal-immaġni tar-reżonanza manjetika bħala għodda għad-dijanjosi medika.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Erba’ snin wara ngħatat privattiva, li kienet l-ewwel privattiva tad-dinja maħruġa fil-qasam tal-MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Fl-1977, Dr Damadian temm il-kostruzzjoni tal-ewwel skener tal-MRI “tal-ġisem kollu”, li huwa sejħu “Invinċibbli”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Komunikazzjoni mhux sinkronika tħeġġeġ ħin ta' riflessjoni u reazzjoni għall-oħrajn.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Dan jagħti lill-istudenti l-abbiltà li jaħdmu bil-pass tagħhom u jikkontrollaw il-veloċità tal-informazzjoni ta’ struzzjoni.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Barra minn hekk, hemm inqas restrizzjonijiet ta’ ħin bil-possibbiltà ta’ ħinijiet tax-xogħol flessibbli. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L-użu tal-internet u l-World Wide Web jippermetti lill-istudenti li jkollhom aċċess għall-informazzjoni l-ħin kollu.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: L-istudenti jistgħu wkoll jibagħtu mistoqsijiet lill-għalliema fi kwalunkwe ħin tal-ġurnata u jistennew tweġibiet raġonevolment malajr, pjuttost milli jistennew sal-laqgħa wiċċ imb’ wiċċ li jmiss.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L-approċċ postmodern għat-tagħlim joffri l-ħelsien mill-assoluti. M'hemmx mod wieħed biss tajjeb biex titgħallem.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Fil-fatt, m’hemmx ħaġa waħda tajba x’titgħallem. It-tagħlim isir fl-esperjenza bejn l-istudent u l-għarfien ippreżentat.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: L-esperjenza kurrenti tagħna bl-ispettakli kollha tat-televiżjoni bbażati fuq it-tagħlim dwar kif tagħmel l-affarijiet int stess u l-preżentazzjoni tal-informazzjoni turi dan il-punt.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Ħafna minna nsibu lilna nfusna qed naraw programm televiżiv li jagħtina informazzjoni dwar proċess jew esperjenza li m'aħna se nipparteċipaw fihom qatt jew li qatt mhux se napplikaw dik l-informazzjoni.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Aħna qatt ma nagħmlu overhaul ta' karozza, nibnu funtana fil-bitħa ta' wara tagħna, nivvjaġġaw għall-Peru biex neżaminaw fdalijiet qodma, jew nirrimudellaw id-dar tal-ġar tagħna.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Grazzi għal konnessjonijiet ta' kejbils tal-fibra ottika taħt il-baħar mal-Ewropa u s-satellita tal-broadband, Greenland hija konnessa sew u 93% tal-popolazzjoni tagħha għandha aċċess għall-internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Il-lukanda jew l-ospiti tiegħek (jekk se tkun toqgħod f'dar privata li takkomoda l-mistednin bi ħlas jew f'dar privata) probabbilment ikollhom il-wifi jew PC ikkonnettjat mal-internet, u l-komunitajiet kollha għandhom stabbiliment bl-aċċess għall-internet jew xi post bil-wifi pubbliku.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Kif imsemmi hawn fuq, għalkemm il-kelma "Eskimo" għadha aċċettabbli fl-Istati Uniti, din hija meqjusa bħala mhux rispettuża minn ħafna popli tal-Artiku mhux tal-Istati Uniti, speċjalment fil-Kanada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Waqt li tista' tisma' l-kelma użata mill-Indiġeni Greenlandiżi, l-użu tagħha għandu jiġi evitat mill-barranin.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: L-abitanti indiġeni ta’ Greenland isejħu lilhom infushom Inuit fil-Kanada u Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), Greenlander, ġewwa Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Il-kriminalità, u l-barranin b’intenzjonijiet ħżiena b’mod ġenerali, prattikament ma jeżistux fi Greenland. Anke fil-bliet, m’hemmx "partijiet mhux sikuri."
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Forsi l-kesħa hija l-uniku periklu reali li se jiffaċċjaw dawk li ma jkunux ippreparati għalih.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Jekk iżżur Greenland matul l-istaġuni kesħin (meta tqis li iktar ma tersaq lejn it-Tramuntana, iktar ikun hemm kesħa), importanti li tieħu miegħek ħwejjeġ isaħħnu biżżejjed.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Il-ġranet twal ħafna fis-sajf jistgħu joħolqu problemi biex torqod biżżejjed u kwistjonijiet tas-saħħa assoċjati.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Fis-sajf, oqgħod attent ukoll għan-nemus Nordiku. Għalkemm ma jittrażmettu ebda mard, jistgħu jkunu irritanti.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Waqt li l-ekonomija ta' San Francisco hija marbuta mal-fatt li hija attrazzjoni turistika fost l-aqwa fid-dinja, l-ekonomija tagħha hija ddiversifikata.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: L-ikbar setturi tal-impjiegi huma s-servizzi professjonali, il-gvern, il-finanzi, il-kummerċ u t-turiżmu.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ir-rappreżentazzjoni frekwenti tagħha fil-mużika, films, letteratura u kultura popolari għenet biex tagħmel il-belt u l-postijiet famużi tagħha jkunu magħrufa mad-dinja kollha.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco żviluppat infrastruttura turistika kbira b’bosta lukandi, ristoranti, u faċilitajiet għal konvenzjonijiet ta’ livell għoli.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco hija wkoll wieħed mill-aħjar postijiet fin-nazzjon għal kċina Asjatika oħra: Korean, Tajlandiż, Indjan, u Ġappuniż.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: L-ivvjaġġar għad-Dinja ta' Walt Disney jirrappreżenta pellegrinaġġ ewlieni għal ħafna familji Amerikani.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Iż-żjara "tipika" tinvolvi titjira sal-Ajruport Internazzjonali ta' Orlando, vjaġġ bix-xarabank għal-lukanda ta' Disney fuq il-post, tqatta' madwar ġimgħa mingħajr ma titlaq mill-proprjetà ta' Disney, u tirritorna d-dar.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Hemm numru infinit ta' varjazzjoniiet possibbli, imma din tibqa' dak li jfissru ħafna nies meta jgħidu li "sejrin Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Bosta biljetti li jinbiegħu onlajn permezz ta’ siti web ta' rkant bħal eBay jew Craigslist huma biljetti li parzjalment diġà huma użati għal żjarat ġewwa parks differenti fuq ħafna ġranet differenti.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Waqt li din hija attività komuni ħafna, hija pprojbita minn Disney: il-biljetti mhumiex trasferibbli.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kwalunkwe kkampjar taħt ix-xifer tal-Grand Canyon jirrikjedi permess taż-żoni rurali.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Il-permessi huma limitati biex jipproteġu l-kanjon, u jsiru disponibbli fl-ewwel jum tax-xahar, erba’ xhur qabel ix-xahar tal-bidu.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Għalhekk, permess taż-żoni rurali għal xi data tal-bidu f'Mejju jsir disponibbli fl-1 ta' Jannar.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: L-ispazju għaż-żoni l-iktar popolari, bħall-Bright Angel Campground maġenb Phantom Ranch, ġeneralment jimtlew b’talbiet għal prenotazzonijiet li jaslu mal-ewwel data li jinfetħu għall-prenotazzjonijiet.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Hemm numru limitat ta' permessi rriservati għal talbiet minn persuni bla appuntament disponibbli fuq il-bażi ta' min jiġi l-ewwel jinqeda l-ewwel.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
