text: Id-dħul fl-Afrika t’Isfel bil-karozza huwa mod fenomenali kif tara s-sbuħija kollha tar-reġjun kif ukoll biex tmur f’postijiet li mhumiex fir-rotot turistiċi normali.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Dan jista' jsir f'karozza normali b'ippjanar bir-reqqa imma 4x4 huwa rrakkomandat ħafna u bosta postijiet huma aċċessibbli biss b'bażi 4x4 ta' roti għoljin.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Waqt li tkun qed tippjana, żomm f’moħħok li għalkemm l-Afrika t’Isfel hija pajjiż stabbli mhux il-pajjiżi ġirien tagħha kollha huma stabbli bħalha.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Il-ħtiġijiet u l-ispejjeż tal-viża jvarjaw bejn nazzjon u ieħor u huma affettwati mill-pajjiż li tiġi minnu.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Kull pajjiż għandu wkoll liġijiet uniċi li jkollhom rekwiżiti ta’ liema oġġetti ta’ emerġenza għandhom ikunu fil-karozza.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls hija belt fil-parti tal-Punent taż-Żimbabwe, kif taqsam il-fruntiera minn Livingstone, fiż-Żambja, u qrib il-Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Il-belt tinsab immedjatament ħdejn il-kaskati, u huma l-attrazzjoni ewlenija, imma din id-destinazzjoni turistika popolari toffri ħafna opportunitajiet għal soġġorn itwal kemm lil dawk li jfittxu l-avventuri kif ukoll lil dawk li jħobbu jaraw il-veduti u l-postijiet ta' interess.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Fl-istaġun tax-xita (Novembru sa Marzu), il-volum tal-ilma se jkun ogħla u l-Kaskati se jkunu aktar drammatiċi.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Għandek garanzija li tixxarrab jekk taqsam minn fuq il-pont jew timxi matul il-mogħdijiet qrib il-Kaskati.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Min-naħa l-oħra, huwa preċiżament minħabba li l-volum tal-ilma huwa tant kbir li l-veduta tiegħek tal-Falls attwali se jkun mgħottija—minħabba l-ilma kollu!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Il-Qabar ta' Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 jista' jkun l-aktar famuż mill-oqbra fil-Wied, il-post tal-iskoperta ta' Howard Carter fl-1922 tad-dfin irjali kważi intatt tar-re żagħżugħ.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Meta mqabbel mal-maġġor parti tal-oqbra rjali l-oħra, madankollu, il-qabar ta’ Tutankhamun kważi qas jiswa l-isforz biex iżżuru, minħabba li huwa ħafna iżgħar u mhux dekorat wisq.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Kull min huwa interessat li jara l-evidenza tal-ħsara li saret lill-mumja meta ppruvaw ineħħuha mit-tebut se jkun iddiżappuntat għax ir-ras u l-ispallejn biss huma viżibbli.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Ir-rikkezzi favolużi li kien hemm fil-kripta m’għadhomx fih, iżda ttieħdu fil-Mużew Eġizzjan ġewwa Kajr.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Il-viżitaturi b'ħin limitat jaqblilhom iqattgħu il-ħin tagħhom x'imkien ieħor.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km fil-Lbiċ ta’ Siem Reap. Dan it-tempju fuq l-għoljiet inbena fl-aħħar tas-seklu 9, matul ir-renju tar-Re Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L-atmosfera melankolika tat-tempju u l-veduta fuq il-lag Tonle Sap jagħmluha utli li titla’ t-telgħa mal-għolja.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Żjara lis-sit tista’ tkun kkombinata b’mod konvenjenti ma’ dawra bid-dgħajsa fil-lag.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Il-Pass tal-Angkor huwa essenzjali biex tidħol fit-tempju, mela tinsiex tieħu l-passaport tiegħek meta tkun sejjer Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Ġerusalemm hija l-belt kapitali u l-ikbar belt ta’ Iżrael, għalkemm ħafna pajjiżi oħra u n-Nazzjonijiet Uniti ma jirrikonoxxuhiex bħala l-belt kapitali ta’ Iżrael.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Il-belt antika fl-Għoljien Ġudeani (“Judean Hills”) għandha storja affaxxinanti li hija twila eluf ta’ snin.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Il-belt hija sagra għat-tliet reliġjonijiet monoteistiċi - il-Ġudaiżmu, il-Kristjaneżmu u l-Islam, u sservi bħala ċentru spiritwali, reliġjuż u kulturali.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Minħabba s-sinifikat reliġjuż tal-belt, u b’mod partikolari l-ħafna siti taż-żona tal-Belt il-Qadima, il-Ġerusalemm hija waħda mid-destinazzjonijiet turistiċi ewlenin fl-Iżrael.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Ġerusalemm għandha bosta siti storiċi, arkeoloġiċi u kulturali, kif ukoll ċentri tax-xiri, kafetteriji, u ristoranti vibranti u mimlijin bin-nies.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: L-Ekwador jirrikjedi li ċ-Ċittadini Kubani jirċievu ittra ta’ stedina qabel jidħlu fl-Ekwador permezz ta’ ajruporti internazzjonali jew punti ta’ dħul fil-fruntiera.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Din l-ittra trid tiġi llegalizzata mill-Ministeru għall-Affarijiet Barranin tal-Ekwador, u tkun konformi ma' ċerti rekwiżiti.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Dawn ir-rekwiżiti huma mfasslin biex jipprovdu fluss migratorju organizzat bejn iż-żewġ pajjiżi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Ċittadini Kubani li għandhom kard ħadra tal-Istati Uniti għandhom iżuru l-Konsulat Ekwadorjan biex jiksbu eżenzjoni għal dan ir-rekwiżit.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Il-passaport tiegħek irid ikun validu għal mill-inqas 6 xhur lil hinn mid-dati tal-ivvjaġġar tiegħek. Biljett tal-vjaġġ bir-ritorn/li jkompli għal postijiet oħra huwa meħtieġ bħala prova tat-tul tas-soġġorn tiegħek.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Il-vjaġġi huma orħos għal gruppi aktar kbar, għalhekk jekk inti waħdek jew ma' ħabib wieħed biss, ipprova ltaqa' ma' nies oħra u fforma grupp ta' minn erba' sa sitta għal rata aħjar kull persuna.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Madankollu, dan m’għandux ikun sors ta’ tħassib tiegħek fir-realtà, għax ħafna drabi t-turisti jitħalltu biex jimlew il-karozzi.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Fil-fatt jidher li dawn huwa aktar mod kif wieħed jinganna lin-nies biex jaħsbu li jridu jħallsu iktar.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Tiddomina t-tarf tat-Tramuntana ta' Machu Picchu hemm din il-muntanja wieqfa, ta' spiss l-isfond ta' ħafna ritratti tal-fdalijiet.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Tidher daqsxejn intimidanti minn taħt, u hija telgħa wieqfa u diffiċli, iżda ħafna mill-persuni li huma b’saħħithom b’mod raġonevoli għandhom ikunu jistgħu jagħmluha f’madwar 45 minuta.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Turġien tal-ġebel huma mqiegħda tul il-biċċa l-kbira tal-mogħdija, u fis-sezzjonijiet aktar wieqfa kejbils tal-azzar jipprovdu poġġaman ta’ appoġġ.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: B’kunsiderazzjoni ta’ dan, stenna li taqta’ nifsek, u oqgħod attent fil-porzjonijiet iktar weqfin, speċjalment meta jkunu mxarrbin, għax is-sitwazzjoni tista’ malajr issir perikoluża.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Hemm għar ċkejken ħafna qrib il-quċċata li trid tgħaddi minnu, li huwa pjuttost baxx u dejjaq.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: L-aħjar mod biex tara s-siti u l-annimali slavaġ tal-Galapagos huwa bid-dgħajsa, kif għamel Charles Darwin fl-1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Iktar minn 60 vapur tal-kruċieri jaħdmu fl-ilmijiet tal-Galapagos - li jvarjaw fid-daqs ta’ bejn 8 sa 100 passiġġier.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Bosta nies jibbukkjaw il-post tagħhom ħafna qabel (peress li d-dgħajjes normalment ikunu mimlijin tul l-iktar staġun popolari).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Kun żgur li l-aġent li qed tibbukkja miegħu jkun speċjalista tal-Galapagos u jkun infurmat sew dwar il-varjetà kbira ta’ vapuri.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Dan se jiżgura li l-interessi u/jew il-limitazzjonijiet partikulari tiegħek jiġu mqabbla mal-vapur l-aktar xieraq għalihom.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Qabel il-wasla tal-Ispanjoli fis-seklu 16, iċ-Ċilì ta’ Fuq kien maħkum mill-Inca filwaqt li l-Arawċani indiġeni (Mapuche) kienu jgħixu fiċ-Ċentru u fiċ-Ċilì ta’ Isfel.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Il-Mapuche kienu wkoll wieħed mill-aħħar gruppi indiġeni Amerikani indipendenti, li ma ġewx kompletament assorbiti fil-ħakma ta’ dawk li jitkellmu bl-Ispanjol qabel l-indipendenza taċ-Ċilì.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Għalkemm iċ-Ċili ddikjara l-indipendenza fl-1810 (f'nofs il-gwerer Napoleoniċi li għal ftit snin ikkaġunaw li Spanja tkun mingħajr gvern ċentrali li jiffunzjona), ir-rebħa deċiżiva fuq l-Ispanjoli ma nkisbitx qabel l-1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Ir-Repubblika Dominikana (bl-Ispanjol: República Dominicana) huwa pajjiż tal-Karibew li jokkupa n-nofs tal-Lvant tal-gżira ta’ Hispaniola, li jaqsam ma’ Haiti
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Apparti bajjiet bir-ramel abjad u pajsaġġi muntanjużi, il-pajjiż fih l-iktar belt Ewropea antika fl-Amerki, li issa tifforma parti minn Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Il-gżira kienet l-ewwel waħda abitata mit-Taínos u l-Karibes. Il-Karibes kienu nies li jitkellmu bl-Arawakan u li waslu bejn wieħed u ieħor fl-10,000 Q.E.K.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Wara ftit snin mill-wasla tal-esploraturi Ewropej, il-popolazzjoni ta' Tainos kienet tnaqqset b'mod sinifikanti mill-konkwistaturi Spanjoli.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Fuq il-bażi ta’ Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) bejn l-1492 u l-1498 il-konkwistaturi Spanjoli qatlu madwar 100,000 Taínos.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Dan l-ispazju nbena bħala l-atriju għal kunvent tas-seklu 17, li l-uniku bini li jifdal minnu huwa t-Templo de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Issa tiffunzjona bħala l-pjazza ċentrali, u dejjem hemm ħafna affarijiet għaddejjin fiha, lejl u nhar.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Hemm numru ta' ristoranti li jdawru l-ġnien u hemm, ħafna drabi wara nofsinhar u flgħaxija, ikun hemm kunċerti bla ħlas mill-gazebo ċentrali.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (is-Sqaq tal-Bewsa). Żewġ galleriji 69 ċentimetri biss 'il bogħod minn xulxin jiffurmaw parti minn leġġenda antika tal-imħabba.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Jekk tagħtihom xi muniti hemm tfal li jirrakkontawlek l-istorja.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Il-Gżira Bowen hija magħrufa għal vjaġġ ta’ jum  jew bħala eskursjoni ta’ tmiem il-ġimgħa li toffri dawriet bil-kayak, hikes, xiri, ristoranti, u aktar.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Din il-komunità awtentika tinsab f'Howe Sound ftit 'il bogħod minn Vancouver, u hija aċċessibbli faċilment permezz tat-taksis tal-ilma skedati li jitilqu mill-Gżira ta' Granville fiċ-ċentru ta' Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Għal dawk li jħobbu l-attivitajiet fil-beraħ, huwa essenzjali li jagħmlu trek tul il-kuritur “Sea to Sky”.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 siegħa sewqan minn Vancouver) huwa għali imma huwa magħruf ħafna minħabba l-Olimpijadi tax-xitwa tal-2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Fix-xitwa, gawdi wieħed mill-aqwa post ta' skijar fl-Amerika ta’ Fuq, u fis-sajf ipprova ċ-ċikliżmu awtentiku tal-muntanji.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Il-permessi għandhom jiġu prenotati minn qabel. Irid ikollok permess biex tqatta’ lejl ġewwa Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena huwa l-uniku stazzjon tal-gwardjani tal-foresti li joffri alloġġ fid-dormitorju u ikel sħun flimkien mal-ikkampjar. La Leona, San Pedrillo, u Los Patos joffru kkampjar biss mingħajr servizz ta’ ikel.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Huwa possibbli li jiġu miksuba permessi tal-park direttament mill-Istazzjon tar-Rangers fi Puerto Jiménez, iżda dawn ma jaċċettawx karti ta’ kreditu
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Is-Servizz tal-Park (MINAE) ma joħroġx permessi tal-park aktar minn xahar qabel il-wasla antiċipata.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol joffri servizz ta’ prenotazzjonijiet għal tariffa ta’ US$30, jew $10 għal passes ta’ ġurnata; iktar dettalji fuq il-paġna Corcovado tagħhom.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Il-Gżejjer Cook huma pajjiż ta’ gżejjer f’assoċjazzjoni ħielsa ma’ New Zealand, li jinsabu fil-Polineżja, f’nofs l-Oċean Paċifiku tan-Nofsinhar.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Huwa arċipelagu bi 15-il gżira mifruxin fuq 2.2 miljuni km2 ta’ oċean.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Minħabba li jinsabu fl-istess żona tal-ħin bħall-Hawaii, il-gżejjer kultant iqisuhom bħala "Hawaii tan-Nofsinhar".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Għalkemm iżgħar, din tfakkar lil xi viżitaturi anzjani f'Hawaii qabel saret stat mingħajr il-ħafna lukandi kbar tat-turisti u żvilupp ieħor.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Il-Gżejjer Cook m’għandhom ebda bliet iżda huma magħmulin minn 15-il gżira differenti. Dawk ewlenin huma Rarotonga u Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Fil-pajjiżi żviluppati llum, il-provvediment ta’ “bed and breakfast” (sodda u kolazzjon) ta’ lussu ttella’ fuq livell ta’ forma ta’ arti.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Fil-medda għolja, il-B&Bs ovvjament jikkompetu l-aktar fuq żewġ affarijiet ewlenin: is-sodod u l-kolazzjon.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Għaldaqstant, fl-ifjen stabbilimenti ta' dan it-tip wieħed xieraq li jsib l-aktar affarijiet tas-sodda lussużi, forsi xi kwilt magħmula bl-idejn jew sodda antika.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Il-kolazzjon jista’ jinkludi delizzji staġjonali tar-reġjun jew il-platt ta’ speċjalità tal-ospitant.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: L-ambjent jista' jkun bini storiku antik bl-għamara antika, ġonna miżmumin sbieħ u pixxina.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Li tidħol fil-karozza tiegħek stess u tagħmel vjaġġ twil bit-triq huwa appellanti fih innifsu minħabba s-sempliċità tiegħu.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: B'kuntrast ma' vetturi akbar, inti probabbilment diġà familjari mas-sewqan tal-karozza tiegħek u taf il-limitazzjonijiet tagħha.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: It-twaqqif ta’ tinda fuq proprjetà privata jew f’belt ta’ kwalunkwe daqs jista’ faċilment jiġbed attenzjoni mhux mixtieqa.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Fil-qosor, l-użu tal-karozza tiegħek huwa mod tajjeb ħafna biex tagħmel vjaġġ twil bit-triq imma, fih innifsu, rari huwa mod biex "tikkampja".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Possibbli li tikkampja bil-karozza jekk ikollok minivan kbir, SUV, Sedan jew Station Wagon b’sits li jinżlu kompletament.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Ċerti lukandi għandhom wirt mill-epoka tad-deheb ta' ferroviji tal-fwar u bastimenti tal-passiġġieri fl-oċean; qabel it-Tieni Gwerra Dinjija, fis-seklu 19 jew fil-bidu tas-seklu 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Dawn il-lukandi kienu l-postijiet li jienu joqogħdu fihom is-sinjuri u n-nies famużi ta' dak iż-żmien, u spiss kellhom ikel tajjeb u divertiment tul il-lejl.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: L-aċċessorji antiki, in-nuqqas ta' kumditajiet moderni, u ċerta antikità grazzjuża huma wkoll parti mill-karattru tagħhom.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Waqt li ġeneralment huma ta' sjieda privata, xi kultant huma jakkomodaw lill-kapijiet tal-istat u dinjitjarji oħra li jkunu fuq żjara.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Vjaġġatur sinjur ħafna jista’ jikkunsidra titjira madwar id-dinja kollha, maqsuma f’soġġorni ġewwa ħafna minn dawn il-lukandi.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Netwerk ta' skambju tal-ospitalità hija organizzazzjoni li tikkonnettja l-vjaġġaturi man-nies tal-lokal fil-bliet li huma se jżuru.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Biex tidħol f'netwerk bħal dan, normalment trid biss timla formola onlajn; għalkemm xi netwerks joffru, jew jirrikjedu, verifika addizzjonali.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Lista tal-ospiti disponibbli imbagħad tiġi pprovduta pprintjata u/jew online, xi kultant bir-referenzi u l-opinjoni dwarhom ta' vjaġġaturi oħra.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Il-couchsurfing ġie mwaqqaf f’Jannar 2004 wara li l-programmatur tal-kompjuter Casey Fenton sab titjira rħisa lejn l-Iżlanda iżda ma kellux fejn joqgħod.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Huwa bagħat email lill-istudenti tal-università lokali u rċieva għadd kbir ħafna ta’ offerti għal akkomodazzjoni mingħajr ħlas.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Il-ħostels, primarjament, huma maħsubin għaż-żgħażagħ – viżitatur tipiku jkun fl-għoxrinijiet – imma ħafna drabi tista’ ssib vjaġġaturi ikbar fl-età ukoll.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Ma tantx tara familji bit-tfal, iżda xi ħostels jaċċettawhom fi kmamar privati.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Il-belt ta’ Beijing fiċ-Ċina se tkun il-belt li tospita l-Logħob Olimpiku tax-Xitwa fl-2022, li se jagħmilha l-ewwel belt li ospitat kemm l-Olimpjadi tas-sajf kif ukoll dawk tax-xitwa.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing se tospita ċ-ċerimonji tal-ftuħ u tal-għeluq u l-avvenimenti tas-silġ fuq ġewwa.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Avvenimenti oħra tal-iskijjar se jkunu fiż-żona tal-iskijjar ta’ Taizicheng ġewwa Zhangjiakou, madwar 220 km (140 mil) minn Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Bosta tempji għandhom festival Annwali li jibda minn Novembru sa nofs Mejju, dan ivarja skont il-kalendarju annwali ta’ kull tempju.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Il-biċċa l-kbira tal-festivals tat-tempji huma ċċelebrati bħala parti mill-anniversarju tat-tempju jew għeluq snin tal-alla li jippresjedi jew kwalunkwe avveniment maġġuri ieħor assoċjat mat-tempju.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Il-festivals tat-tempji ta’ Kerala interessanti ħafna biex tarahom, b’purċissjoni regolari ta’ iljunfanti mżejnin, orkestra tat-tempju u ċelebrazzjonijiet oħrajn.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Fiera Dinjija (komunement imsejħa Espożizzjoni Dinjija, jew sempliċement “Expo”) hija festival internazzjonali kbir tal-arti u x-xjenzi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Il-pajjiżi parteċipanti jippreżentaw wirjiet artistiċi u edukattivi f’paviljuni nazzjonali biex juru kwistjonijiet tad-dinja jew il-kultura u l-istorja ta’ pajjiżhom.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Eżibizzjonijiet Internazzjonali tal-Ortikultura huma avvenimenti speċjalizzati li jinkludu wirjiet tal-fjuri, ġonna botaniċi u kull ħaġa oħra li għandha x’taqsam mal-pjanti.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Għalkemm fit-teorija huma jistgħu jsiru kull sena (sakemm isiru f'pajjiżi differenti), fil-prattika ma jsirux.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Dawn l-avvenimenti normalment idumu bejn tlieta u sitt xhur, u jiġu organizzati f'siti mhux iżgħar minn 50 ettaru.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Hemm ħafna formati differenti ta' films li ntużaw matul is-snin. Il-film standard ta' 35 mm (in-negattivi 36 b'24 mm) huwa żgur l-aktar komuni.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Normalment jista’ jerġa’ jimtela pjuttost faċilment jekk jispiċċalek, u jagħti riżoluzzjoni bejn wieħed u ieħor paragunabbli ma’ DSLR kurrenti.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Xi kameras ta’ films b’format medju jużaw format ta’ 6 cm b’6 cm, b’mod iktar preċiż negattiv ta’ 56 mm b’56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Dan jipprovdi riżoluzzjoni kważi erba' darbiet ikbar minn dik ta' negattiva ta' 35 mm (3136 mm2 kontra 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Il-ħlejjaq selvaġġi huma fost il-motifi li joffru l-akbar sfida lill-fotografu, u teħtieġ taħlita ta' xorti tajba, paċenzja, esperjenza u tagħmir tajjeb.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Il-fotografija tal-ħlejjaq selvaġġi ħafna drabi ma nagħtux kasha, imma bħall-fotografija b'mod ġenerali, stampa waħda tiswa daqs elf kelma.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Il-fotografija tal-ħlejjaq selvaġġi ħafna drabi teħtieġ lenti telefoto twila, għalkemm affarijiet bħal qatta għasafar jew ħlejqa ċkejkna jeħtieġu lentijiet oħrajn.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ħafna annimali eżotiċi diffiċli ssibhom, u l-parks kultant ikollhom regoli dwar it-teħid ta’ ritratti għal skopijiet kummerċjali.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: L-annimali selvaġġi jistgħu jistħu jew ikunu aggressivi. L-ambjent jista' jkun kiesaħ, sħun, jew ostili b'xi mod ieħor.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Id-dinja għandha aktar minn 5,000 lingwi differenti, inklużi iktar minn għoxrin b'50 miljun persuni li jitkellmuhom jew iktar.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Il-kliem miktuba ta' spiss huma aktar faċli biex jiġu mifhuma milli l-kliem mitkellma, ukoll. Dan huwa partikularment vera għall-indirizzi, li ħafna drabi huma diffiċli biex tippronunzjahom b'mod li tiġi mifhum.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Ħafna nazzjonijiet sħaħ huma kompletament fluwenti bl-Ingliż, u f’saħansitra ħafna iktar tista’ tistenna għarfien limitat - speċjalment fost iż-żgħażagħ.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Immaġina, jekk trid, xi Mancunian, Bostonian, Ġamajkan u Sydneysider bilqiegħda madwar mejda jieklu ġewwa ristorant f’Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Qed iferrħu lil xulxin bi stejjer mill-ibliet tagħhom, imlissna bl-aċċenti distinti u l-lingwaġġ partikulari lokali tagħhom.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ix-xiri tal-ikel fis-supermarkits ġeneralment huwa l-irħas mod kif tista’ titma’ lilek innifsek. Mingħajr opportunitajiet ta’ tisjir, l-għażliet madankollu huma limitati għal ikel lest.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Dejjem aktar, is-supermarkits qed ikollhom sezzjoni aktar varjata ta’ ikel lest. Xi wħud saħansitra jipprovdu majkrowejv jew mezzi oħra biex isaħħan l-ikel.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: F’xi pajjiżi jew tipi ta’ ħwienet hemm mill-inqas ristorant wieħed fuq il-post, ħafna drabi wieħed pjuttost informali bi prezzijiet raġonevoli.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Ħu kopji tal-polza tiegħek u tad-dettalji tal-kuntatt tal-kumpanija tal-assigurazzjoni tiegħek u ġorrhom miegħek.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Iridu juru l-indirizz elettroniku tal-assiguratur u n-numri tal-telefon internazzjonali għall-pariri/awtorizzazzjonijiet u biex jagħmlu l-klejms.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Żomm kopja oħra fil-bagalja tiegħek u waħda online (ibgħat email lilek innifsek bl-anness, jew aħżinha fuq il-"cloud").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Jekk tkun qed tivvjaġġa b’laptop jew tablet, aħżen kopja fil-memorja jew id-diska tiegħu (aċċessibbli mingħajr l-internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Ukoll agħti kopji tal-politika/kuntatt lill-imsieħba vjaġġaturi u qraba jew ħbieb f'pajjiżek li lesti jgħinu.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Il-”moose” (ċriev kbar tal-Amerika tat-Tramuntana) (magħrufin ukoll bħala elk) mhumiex aggressivi b’mod inerenti, iżda jiddefendu lilhom infushom jekk jipperċepixxu theddida.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Meta n-nies ma jqisux lill-elk bħala potenzjalment perikoluż, jistgħu jersqu qrib wisq u jpoġġu lilhom infushom f'riskju.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Ixrob alkoħol b’moderazzjoni. L-alkoħol jaffettwa lil kulħadd differenti, u li tkun taf il-limitu tiegħek huwa importanti ħafna.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Avvenimenti tas-saħħa fit-tul possibbli minħabba xorb eċċessiv jistgħu jinkludu ħsara fil-fwied u anke għama u mewt. Il-periklu potenzjali jiżdied meta tikkonsma alkoħol prodott illegalment.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: L-ispirti illegali jista’ jkun fihom diversi impuritajiet perikolużi inkluż il-metanol, li jista’ jikkawża għama jew mewt anke f’dożi żgħar.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: In-nuċċalijiet jistgħu jkunu orħos f’pajjiż barrani, speċjalment f’pajjiżi bi dħul baxx fejn l-ispejjeż tax-xogħol ikunu aktar baxxi.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Ikkunsidra li tagħmel eżami tal-għajnejn id-dar, speċjalment jekk l-assigurazzjoni tkopriha, u ġġib ir-riċetta miegħek biex tiġi ppreżentata x’imkien ieħor.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Frejms tad-ditta tal-ogħla livell disponibbli f’oqsma bħal dawn jista’ jkollhom żewġ problemi; xi wħud jistgħu kopji, u dawk importati reali jistgħu jkunu jiswew aktar milli d-dar.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Il-kafè huwa wieħed mill-aktar prodotti nnegozjati fid-dinja, u probabbilment tista’ ssib ħafna tipi differenti fir-reġjun tad-dar tiegħek.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Madankollu, hemm ħafna modi differenti kif tixrob il-kafè fid-dinja li sabiħ tesperjenzahom.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Il-canyoning (jew canyoneering) jinvolvi li tmur f’qiegħ ta’ canyon, li huwa jew niexef jew mimli ilma.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Il-canyoning jikkombina elementi mill-għawm, it-tixbit u l-qbiż--iżda jeħtieġ relattivament ftit taħriġ jew forma fiżika biex tkun tista’ tibda (meta mqabbel ma’ tixbit mal-blat, scuba diving jew ski alpin, pereżempju).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Il-mixi fuq hikes huwa attività fil-beraħ li tikkonsisti f’mixi ġewwa ambjenti naturali, ħafna drabi fuq mogħdijiet għall-hikes.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Il-hikes ta’ ġurnata jinvolvu distanzi li jibdew minn inqas minn mil sa distanzi itwal li jistgħu jsiru f’ġurnata waħda.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Għal hike ta’ ġurnata fuq perkors faċli m’hemmx bżonn ta’ wisq preparamenti, u kwalunkwe persuna f’saħħa moderatament tajba tista’ tagħmilha.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Il-familji bi tfal żgħar jista’ jkollhom bżonn aktar preparamenti, iżda ġurnata barra hija possibbli faċilment anke bi trabi u tfal żgħar.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internazzjonalment, hemm kważi 200 organizzazzjoni ta’ turs għall-ġiri. Ħafna minnhom jaħdmu b’mod indipendenti.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Is-suċċessur ta’ Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours tgħaqqad netwerks ta’ għexieren ta’ fornituri ta’ tlielaq bil-veduti (“sightrunning”) fuq erba’ kontinenti.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: B'rabtiet mat-Tours tal-Ġiri f'Barċellona ta' Barċellona u l-Ġiri f'Copenhagen ta' Copenhagen, malajr ingħaqdu miegħu t-Tours tal-Ġiri f'Praga bbażat fi Praga u oħrajn.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Hemm ħafna affarijiet li trid tqis qabel u meta tivvjaġġa għal x'imkien.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Meta tivvjaġġa, stenna affarijiet li ma jkunux bħal ma huma "f'pajjiżek". Il-manjieri, il-liġijiet, l-ikel, it-traffiku, il-loġing, l-istandards, il-lingwa u affarijiet bħal dawn se jkunu sa ċertu punt differenti minn dawk ta' fejn tgħix.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Din hija xi ħaġa li dejjem trid iżżomm f'moħħok, biex tevita diżappunt jew forsi anki stmellija dwar il-modi lokali ta' kif tagħmel l-affarijiet.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: L-aġenziji tal-ivvjaġġar ilhom jeżistu mis-seklu 19. Aġent tal-ivvjaġġar huwa ħafna drabi għażla tajba għal vjaġġ li jestendi lil hinn mill-esperjenza preċedenti tal-vjaġġatur tan-natura, il-kultura, il-lingwa jew il-pajjiżi bi dħul baxx.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Għalkemm il-maġġoranza tal-aġenziji lesti li jaċċettaw il-maġġoranza tal-bookings regolari, ħafna aġenti jispeċjalizzaw f'tipi partikulari ta' vvjaġġar, firxiet tal-baġit jew destinazzjonijiet.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Jista’ jkun aħjar li tuża aġent li s-soltu jibbukkja vjaġġi bħal tiegħek.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Agħti ħarsa lejn liema vjaġġi qed jippromwovi l-aġent, kemm jekk fuq sit web jew f’vetrina ta’ ħanut.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Jekk trid tara d-dinja mingħajr ma tonfoq ħafna, għal bżonn, stil ta’ ħajja jew sfida, hemm xi modi kif tista’ tagħmel dan.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Bażikament, dawn jaqgħu f’żewġ kategoriji: Jew aħdem waqt li tivvjaġġa jew inkella ipprova llimita l-ispejjeż tiegħek. Dan l-artikolu jiffoka fuq dik tal-aħħar.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Għal dawk li huma lesti li jissagrifikaw il-kumdità, il-ħin u l-prevedibbiltà biex jifrrankaw tant spejjeż li kważi ma jonfqu xejn, ara l-ivvjaġġar fuq baġit minimu.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Il-parir jassumi li l-vjaġġaturi ma jisirqux, ma jidħlux fi proprjetà ta’ ħaddieħor mingħajr permess, ma jipparteċipawx fis-suq illegali, ma jittallbux, jew jisfruttaw lil nies oħra għall-profitt tagħhom stess.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Checkpoint tal-immigrazzjoni huwa ġeneralment l-ewwel waqfa meta wieħed jinżel minn ajruplan, vapur, jew vettura oħra.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: F’xi ferroviji transkonfinali, l-ispezzjonijiet isiru waqt li l-ferrovija tkun għaddejja u jrid ikollok ID valida miegħek meta titla’ fuq waħda minn dawk il-ferroviji.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Fuq ferroviji tal-irqad, il-passaporti jistgħu jinġabru mill-konduttur biex l-irqad tiegħek ma jiġix interrott.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ir-reġistrazzjoni hija ħtieġa addizzjonali għall-proċess tal-viża. F’xi pajjiżi, trid tirreġistra l-preżenza tiegħek u l-indirizz fejn qed toqgħod mal-awtoritajiet lokali.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Dan jista' jirrikjedi li timla formola tal-pulizija lokali jew iżżur l-uffiċċji tal-immigrazzjoni.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: F’ħafna pajjiżi b’liġi bħal din, il-lukandi lokali se jieħdu ħsieb ir-reġistrazzjoni (kun żgur li tistaqsi).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: F’każijiet oħra, dawk li joqogħdu barra mill-akkomodazzjonijiet turistiċi biss għandhom bżonn jirreġistraw.  Madankollu, dan jagħmel il-liġi ħafna iktar oskura, allura tgħallem dwaru minn qabel.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L-arkitettura tikkonċerna d-disinn u l-kostruzzjoni tal-bini. Ħafna drabi, l-arkitettura ta’ post hija attrazzjoni turistika fiha nfisha.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Hemm ħafna bini sabiħ biex tħares lejh u l-veduta minn bini għoli jew minn tieqa ppożizzjonata sew tista’ tkun verament bellezza biex taraha.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L-arkitettura titrikkeb b’mod konsiderevoli fuq oqsma oħra inkluż l-ippjanar urban, l-inġinerija ċivili, l-arti dekorattiva, id-disinn intern u d-disinn tal-pajsaġġ.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Minħabba l-fatt li ħafna mill-pueblos huma remoti ħafna, mhux se tkun tista’ ssib ammont sinifikanti ta’ ħajja bil-lejl sakemm ma tivvjaġġax lejn Albuquerque jew Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Madankollu, kważi l-każinòs kollha elenkati hawn fuq iservu x-xorb, u bosta minnhom iġibu divertiment ta’ ditti magħrufin (primarjament dawk kbar immedjatament madwar Albuquerque u Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Moħħok hemm: il-bars fil-bliet iż-żgħar mhumiex dejjem postijiet ideali biex jidħol fihom xi ħadd li ma joqgħodx f’dak l-istat.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Minn naħa waħda, it-Tramuntana ta’ New Mexico għandha problemi kbar bis-sewqan fis-sakra, u l-konċentrazzjoni ta’ sewwieqa xurbana hija għolja qrib il-bars tal-ibliet żgħar.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Murali jew taħżiż li mhumiex mixtieqa huma magħrufa bħala graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Waqt li bl-edba mod mhu fenomenu modern, il-maġġoranza tan-nies probabbilment jassoċjawh maż-żgħażagħ li jivvandilizzaw il-proprjetà pubblika u privata bl-użu taż-żebgħa sprejjata.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Madankollu, bħalissa hemm artisti tal-graffiti stabbiliti sew, avvenimenti tal-graffiti u ħitan "legali" . F'dan il-kuntest, il-pitturi tal-graffiti ħafna drabi huma bħal xogħlijiet artistiċi pjuttost milli affarijiet li ma jinqrawx.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: It-tfigħ tal-boomerangs hija ħila popolari li ħafna turisti jixtiequ jiksbuha.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Jekk trid titgħallem titfa’ boomerang li terġa’ tiġi lura f’idejk, kun żgur li jkollok boomerang adattata għar-ritorn.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Ħafna boomerangs disponibbli fl-Awstralja fil-fatt ma jirritornawx. Aħjar li dawk li jkunu għadhom ħa jibdew ma jippruvawx jitfgħu fir-riħ
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Ikla Hangi tiġi msajra ġewwa ħofra sħuna fl-art.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Il-ħofra hija jew imsaħħna b'ġebel jaħraq minn nar, jew f'xi postijiet is-sħana ġeotermali tagħmel xi rqajja' tal-art sħan b'mod naturali.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Il-hangi spiss jintuża biex xi ħadd isajjar ikla mixwija fi stil tradizzjonali.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Diversi postijiet ġewwa Rotorua joffru hangi ġeotermali, filwaqt li jistgħu jittieħdu kampjuni ta' hangi oħra ġewwa Christchurch, Wellington u postijiet oħrajn.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail għandha żewġ klassijiet fuq ferroviji tal-vjaġġaturi ġewwa Cape Town u madwarha: MetroPlus (imsejħa wkoll “First Class” (“Ewwel Klassi”)) u Metro (imsejħa “Third Class” (“Tielet Klassi”)).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus hija iktar komda u inqas iffullata imma tiswa ftit iktar, għalkemm xorta irħas mill-biljetti normali tal-metro fl-Ewropa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Kull ferrovija għandha kemm kowċis MetroPlus kif ukoll kowċis Metro; il-kowċis MetroPlus huma dejjem fit-tarf tal-iktar ferrovija qrib Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Il-ġarr għal ħaddieħor - Titlaqx il-basktijiet tiegħek minn taħt għajnejk, b'mod speċjali jekk tkun qed taqsam il-konfini internazzjonali.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Tista' ssib lilek innifsek qed tintuża bħala kurrier tad-drogi mingħajr ma tkun taf, u dan idaħħlek f'inkwiet kbir.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Dan jinkludi l-istennija f'linja, minħabba li klieb li jxommu d-drogi jistgħu jintużaw fi kwalunkwe ħin mingħajr avviż.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Ċerti pajjiżi għandhom pieni drakonjani b'mod eċċessiv anke jekk reat jitwettaq għall-ewwel darba; dawn jistgħu jinkludu sentenzi ta’ ħabs ta’ iktar minn 10 snin jew mewt.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Basktijiet waħedhom huma mira għas-serq u jistgħu wkoll jiġbdu l-attenzjoni tal-awtoritajiet li huma attenti għat-theddid ta' bombi.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Minħabba dan l-esponiment kostanti għall-mikrobi lokali fid-dar, hemm ċans kbir ħafna li inti diġà għandek immunità għalihom.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Imma f’partijiet oħra tad-dinja, fejn il-fawna batterjoloġika tkun ġdida għalik, iktar għandek ċans li ssib problemi.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Apparti hekk, fi klimi iktar sħan il-batterji jikbru aktar malajr u jdumu iktar ħajjin barra mill-ġisem.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: U għalhekk it-tbatijiet ta' Delhi Belly, is-Saħta tal-Faragħuni, il-vedetta ta' Montezuma, u l-ħafna ħbieb tagħhom.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: B'mod simili għall-problemi respiratorji fi klimi kesħin, il-problemi intestinali fi klimi sħan huma pjuttost komuni u, ħafna drabi, huma tedjanti ħafna imma mhumiex perikolużi fir-realtà.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Jekk tkun qed tivvjaġġa f’pajjiż li qed jiżviluppa għall-ewwel darba – jew f’parti ġdida tad-dinja – tissottovalutax ix-xokk kulturali potenzjali.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Kienu ħafna l-vjaġġaturi stabbli u kapaċi li ġew megħluba bin-novità tal-ivvjaġġar fid-dinja li qed tiżviluppa, fejn ħafna aġġustamenti kulturali żgħar jistgħu jakkumulaw malajr.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Speċjalment fil-ġranet inizjali tiegħek, ikkunsidra li tgawdi l-lukandi, ikel, u servizzi ta’ stil tal-Punent u ta’ kwalità biex tgħin l-akklimatizzazzjoni.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Torqodx fuq saqqu jew kuxxinett mal-art f’żoni fejn m’intix familjari mal-fawna lokali.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Jekk se tagħmel kampeġġ barra, ġib kot tal-ikkampjar jew hammock biex iżommok ’il bogħod minn sriep, skorpjuni u annimali oħrajn.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Imla darek b’kafè qawwi filgħodu u te tal-kamomilla rilassanti filgħaxija.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Meta tkun fi staycation, inti għandek il-ħin għal xi ħaġa li tagħtik gost u biex tuża ftit minuti żejda ħalli tagħmel xi ħaġa speċjali.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Jekk qed tħossok trid iktar avventura, aħtaf l-opportunità biex tagħmel juice jew tibblendja xi smoothies:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: forsi se tiskopri xarba sempliċi li tista’ tagħmilha għall-kolazzjon meta terġa’ lura għar-rutina ta’ kuljum tiegħek.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Jekk tgħix f’belt b’kultura tax-xorb varjata, mur f’bars jew pubs fil-viċinat li ma tiffrekwentax.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Għal dawk li mhumiex familjari mal-lingwaġġ mediku, il-kliem “infettiv” u “kuntaġġuż” għandhom tifsiriet differenti.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Marda li tittieħed hija dik ikkawżata minn patoġenu, bħal virus, batterju, fungu, jew parassiti oħrajn.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Marda li tittieħed hija marda li tiġi trasmessa faċilment billi wieħed ikun fil-viċinanza ta' persuna infettata.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Ħafna gvernijiet jeħtieġu li viżitaturi li jidħlu, jew residenti li jitilqu, mill-pajjiżi tagħhom jiġu mlaqqma għal firxa ta’ mard.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Dawn ir-rekwiżiti jistgħu ħafna drabi jiddependu fuq liema pajjiżi jkun żar jew biħsiebu jżur il-vjaġġatur.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Wieħed mill-punti b’saħħithom ta’ Charlotte, North Carolina, huwa li għandha abbundanza ta’ għażliet ta’ kwalità għolja għall-familji.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Residenti minn żoni oħrajn ħafna drabi jsemmu l-faċilitajiet favur il-familja bħala raġuni primarja biex jiċċaqilqu hemm, u l-viżitaturi spiss isibu li l-belt faċli tgawdiha bit-tfal magħhom.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Fl-aħħar 20 sena, l-ammont ta’ għażliet favur it-tfal ġewwa Uptown Charlotte kiber b’mod esponenzjali.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: It-taksis ġeneralment ma jintużawx mill-familji f’Charlotte, għalkemm jistgħu jkunu utli f’ċerti ċirkostanzi.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Hemm soprataxxa talli jkollok aktar minn 2 passiġġieri, għalhekk din l-għażla tista' tkun aktar għalja milli hemm bżonn.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L-Antartika hija l-aktar post kiesaħ fid-Dinja, u hija mdawra mal-Pol tan-Nofsinhar.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Iż-żjajjar turistiċi huma għaljin, jirrikjedu saħħa fiżika, jistgħu jseħħu biss fis-sajf f'Novembru-Frar, u fil-maġġoranza huma limitati għall-Peniżola, il-Gżejjer u l-Baħar Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Xi elfejn impjegat jgħixu hawn fis-sajf f'xi erba' tużżani bażijiet l-aktar f'dawk iż-żoni; numru żgħir minnhom jibqa' hawn anki fix-xitwa.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: L-Antartika Interna hija pjanura deżolata miksija b’2-3 km silġ.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Turs bl-ajru speċjalizzati okkażjonali jmorru ġewwa fuq l-art, għat-tixbit mal-muntanji jew biex jintlaħaq il-Pol, li għandu bażi kbira.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: It-Traversa tal-Pol tan-Nofsinhar (jew Awtostrada) hija mogħdija ta' 1600 km mill-Istazzjon McMurdo fuq il-Baħar Ross sal-Pol.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Din hija borra kumpattata b’fetħiet fondi fis-silġ tal-glaċieri mimlijin u mmarkati bi bnadar. Wieħed jista’ jgħaddi fuqhom biss jekk ikollu tratturi speċjalizzati, li jiġbdu l-islitti bi fjuwil u provvisti.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Dawn mhumiex ħfief ħafna għalhekk il-mogħdija jkollha tagħmel dawra twila madwar il-Muntanji Transantartiċi biex jaslu fuq il-wita.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: L-iktar raġuni komuni għall-inċidenti fix-xitwa huma toroq, bankini (pavimenti) u partikolarment turġien li jiżolqu.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Bħala minimu, għandek bżonn żarbun b’pett adattat. Iż-żraben tas-sajf ġeneralment jiżolqu ħafna fuq is-silġ u l-borra, anke xi boots tax-xitwa mhumiex tajbin biżżejjed.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Il-mudell irid ikun fond biżżejjed, 5 mm (1/5 ta' pulzier) jew aktar, u l-materjal irid ikun artab biżżejjed f'temperaturi kesħin.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Xi stivali għandhom tappini u hemm tagħmir addizzjonali bit-tappini għal kundizzjonijiet ta' żliq, adattati għall-biċċa l-kbira taż-żraben u l-istivali, għall-għarqbejn jew għarqbejn u l-pett.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: L-għarqbejn iridu jkunu baxxi u wiesgħin. Ramel, żrar jew melħ (klorur tal-kalċju) spiss jixxerrdu fit-toroq jew passaġġi biex ikun hemm trazzjoni aħjar.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Il-valangi mhumiex anormalità; l-għoljiet weqfin jistgħu jżommu biss ammont limitat ta’ silġ, u l-volumi f’eċċess jaqgħu bħala valangi.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Il-problema hi li l-borra teħel, allura trid xi ħaġa li twaqqagħha, u jekk xi borra taqa' tista' tkun l-avveniment li jiskatta l-bqija.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Kultant l-avveniment oriġinali skattatur huwa li x-xemx issaħħan il-borra, xi drabi xi ftit iktar borra, kultant avvenimenti naturali oħra, ħafna drabi bniedem.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tromba tal-arja hija kolonna li ddur fuqha nfisha magħmula minn arja bi pressjoni baxxa ħafna, li tiġbed l-arja ta’ madwarha ’il ġewwa u ’l fuq.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Huma jiġġeneraw irjieħ qawwijin (ħafna drabi 100-200 mil/siegħa) u jistgħu jgħollu oġġetti tqal fl-arja, u jġorruhom hekk kif jiċċaqlaq it-tornado.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Huma jibdew bħala lenbut nieżel mis-sħab tal-maltempata, u jsiru "tornadoes" meta jmissu mal-art.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Fornituri ta’ VPN (netwerk privat virtwali) personali huma mod eċċellenti kif tiġi evitata kemm iċ-ċensura politika kif ukoll il-ġeofiltrazzjoni tal-IP kummerċjali.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Huma superjuri għall-proxies tal-web għal diversi raġunijiet: Huma jbiddlu r-rotta tat-traffiku kollu tal-internet, mhux biss l-http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Normalment huma joffru bandwidth ogħla u kwalità aħjar tas-servizz. Huma kkriptati u għalhekk aktar diffiċli biex jispjunawhom.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Il-kumpaniji tal-midja bħala jigdbu regolarment dwar l-iskop ta’ dan, u jsostnu li dan isir biex "jipprevjenu l-piraterija".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Fil-fatt, il-kodiċijiet tar-reġjun m’għandhom assolutament ebda effett fuq l-ikkupjar illegali; kopja “bit-for-bit” ta’ disk taħdem tajjeb fuq kwalunkwe apparat fejn taħdem il-verżjoni oriġinali.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: L-iskop attwali huwa li dawk il-kumpaniji jingħataw iktar kontroll fuq is-swieq tagħhom; kollox jikkonċerna d-dawrien ta’ flus.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Minħabba li t-telefonati jiġu mgħoddija minn fuq l-Internet, m’għandekx bżonn tuża kumpanija telefonika li tinsab fil-post fejn tgħix jew fejn tivvjaġġa.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: M'hemm ukoll ebda rekwiżit li inti tikseb numru lokali mill-komunità li tgħix fiha; inti tista' tikseb konnessjoni tal-internet bis-satellita fl-artijiet remoti ta' Chicken, fl-Alaska u tagħżel numru li jikklejmja li inti qiegħed f'Arizona xemxija.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Spiss, ikollok tixtri numru globali separatament li jippermetti lit-telefowns PSTN iċemplulek. Il-post li ġej in-numru minnu jagħmel differenza għan-nies li jċemplulek.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Apps għat-tradutturi tat-testi f’ħin reali – applikazzjonijiet li kapaċi jittraduċu segmenti sħaħ ta’ test minn lingwa għal oħra awtomatikament.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Uħud mill-applikazzjonijiet f’din il-kategorija jistgħu saħansitra jittraduċu testi f’lingwi barranin fuq sinjali jew oġġetti oħra fid-dinja reali meta l-utent jipponta l-ismartphone lejn dawk l-oġġetti.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Il-magni tat-traduzzjoni tjiebu drammatikament, u issa ħafna drabi jagħtu traduzzjonijiet ftit jew wisq korretti (u aktar rari tgerwil), imma xi attenzjoni hija dovuta, għax huma xorta jistgħu jiżbaljaw kollox.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Waħda mill-aktar apps prominenti f’din il-kategorija hija “Google Translate”, li tippermetti traduzzjoni offline wara li tniżżel id-dejta tal-lingwa mixtieqa.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: L-użu tal-apps tan-navigazzjoni bil-GPS fuq l-ismartphome tiegħek jista' jkun l-aktar mod faċli u konvenjenti biex tinnaviga meta tkun barra minn pajjiżek.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Jista’ jiffrankalek il-flus flok tixtri mapep ġodda għal GPS, jew apparat tal-GPS awtonomu jew tikri wieħed mingħand kumpanija tal-kiri tal-karozzi.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Jekk m’għandekx konnessjoni tad-dejta għat-telefon tiegħek, jew meta tkun barra mill-firxa ta’ konnessjoni, il-prestazzjoni tagħhom tista’ tkun limitata jew mhux disponibbli.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Kull ħanut tal-merċa huwa mimli b’serje konfondenti ta’ kards tat-telefown imħallsin minn qabel li jistgħu jintużaw minn telefowns pubbliċi jew telefowns normali.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Waqt li l-maġġoranza tal-kards jistgħu jintużaw biex iċċempel fejn trid, uħud huma speċjalizzati biex jipprovdu rati tat-telefonati favorevoli għal gruppi speċifiċi ta' pajjiżi.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L-aċċess għal dawn is-servizzi ta' spiss ikun permezz ta' numru tat-telefon bla ħlas li tista' ċċemplu bla ħlas mill-maġġoranza tal-telefons.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Regoli dwar fotografija regolari huma applikabbli wkoll għall-irrekordjar bil-vidjow, possibbilment saħansitra iktar.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Jekk mhux awtorizzat li tieħu ritratt ta’ xi ħaġa, allura lanqas biss għandek taħsibha li tirrekordja vidjow tagħha.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Jekk tkun qed tuża drone, iċċekkja sew minn qabel dwar x’tista’ tiffilmja u liema permessi jew liċenzji addizzjonali huma meħtieġa.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kważi qatt ma tkun idea tajba li ttajjar drone viċin ajruport jew fuq folla nies, anke jekk dan ma jkunx illegali fl-inħawi tiegħek.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Illum il-ġurnata l-ivvjaġġar bl-ajru rari jiġi bbukkjat direttament permezz tal-linja tal-ajru mingħajr ma l-ewwel isir tiftix u paragunar tal-prezzijiet.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Kultant l-istess titjira jista’ jkollha prezzijiet differenti ħafna f’aggregaturi varji u huwa utli li tqabbel ir-riżultati tat-tiftix u tħares ukoll lejn is-sit web tal-linja tal-ajru stess qabel tibbukkja.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Waqt li jista' ma jkollokx bżonn viża għal żjarat qosra bħala turist jew għan-negozju f'ċerti pajjiżi, meta tmur hemm bħala student internazzjonali ġeneralment teħtieġ soġġorn itwal milli meta tmur hemm bħala turist każwali.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Ġeneralment, jekk toqgħod f'xi pajjiż barrani għal perjodu ta’ żmien estiż se jkollok bżonn takkwista viża minn qabel.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Il-viżi tal-istudenti ġeneralment ikollhom rekwiżiti u proċeduri ta’ applikazzjoni differenti minn viżi normali ta’ turisti jew ta’ negozju.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Għal ħafna pajjiżi, se jkollok bżonn ittra ta’ offerta mill-istituzzjoni li tixtieq tistudja fiha, kif ukoll prova li għandek fondi biex tmantni lilek innifsek għal mill-inqas l-ewwel sena tal-kors tiegħek.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Iċċekkja mal-istituzzjoni, kif ukoll mad-dipartiment tal-immigrazzjoni għall-pajjiż li tixtieq tistudja fih għal ħtiġijiet dettaljati.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Sakemm m'intix diplomatiku, meta taħdem barra mill-pajjiż ġeneralment ifisser li inti jkollok tippreżenta t-taxxa tad-dħul fil-pajjiż li inti bbażat fih.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: It-taxxa fuq id-dħul hija strutturata b’mod differenti f’pajjiżi differenti, u r-rati u s-saffi tat-taxxa jvarjaw ħafna minn pajjiż għal ieħor.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: F’xi pajjiżi federali, bħall-Istati Uniti u l-Kanada, it-taxxa fuq id-dħul hija imposta kemm fil-livell federali kif ukoll fil-livell lokali, għalhekk ir-rati u l-parentesi jistgħu jvarjaw minn reġjun għal ieħor.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Waqt li l-kontroll tal-immigrazzjoni ġeneralment huwa assenti jew formalità biss meta tasal f'pajjiżek, il-kontrolli doganali jistgħu jkunu ta' inkonvenjenza.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Kun żgur li tkun taf x’tista’ u x’ma tistax iddaħħal u tiddikjara kwalunkwe oġġett li jaqbeż il-limiti legali.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: L-eħfef mod biex tibda fin-negozju tal-kitba dwar l-ivvjaġġar huwa li ttejjeb il-ħiliet tiegħek fuq sit web stabbilit ta’ blog tal-ivvjaġġar.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Wara li tidra l-ifformattjar u l-editjar fuq il-web, imbagħad aktar tard, forsi toħloq is-sit web tiegħek.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Il-volontarjat waqt l-ivvjaġġar huwa mod eċċellenti kif tagħmel differenza imma m'huwiex biss dwar li tagħti.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Li tgħix u tagħmel volontarjat f’pajjiż barrani huwa mod tajjeb ħafna kif titgħallem dwar kultura differenti, tiltaqa’ ma’ nies ġodda, titgħallem dwarek innifsek, tikseb sens ta’ perspettiva u anke tikseb ħiliet ġodda.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Jista’ jkun ukoll mod tajjeb biex testendi l-baġit ħalli ttawwal is-soġġorn x’imkien peress li bosta impjiegi ta’ volontarjat jipprovdu kamra u sodda u ftit minnhom iħallsu paga żgħira.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Il-Vikingi użaw ir-rotot fuq l-ilma Russi biex jaslu sal-Baħar l-Iswed u l-Baħar Kaspju. Partijiet minn dawn ir-rotot għadhom jistgħu jintużaw. Iċċekkja jekk potenzjalment hemmx bżonn ta' permessi speċjali, li jistgħu jkunu diffiċli biex jinkisbu.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Il-Kanal Baħar Abjad-Baltiku jikkonnettja l-Oċean Artiku mal-Baħar Baltiku, pemezz tal-Għadira Onega, l-Għadira Ladoga u San Pietruburgu, ġeneralment permezz ta' xmajjar u għadajjar.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Il-Lag Onega huwa marbut ma’ Volga wkoll u, allura, għadu possibbli li wieħed jasal mill-Baħar Kaspju permezz tar-Russja.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kun żgur li ladarba tasal fil-marini kollox ikun pjuttost ċar. Inti se tiltaqa’ ma’ hitchhikers oħra tal-vapuri u dawn se jaqsmu l-informazzjoni tagħhom miegħek.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Bażikament se tkun qed tagħmel avviżi fejn toffri l-għajnuna tiegħek, tippassiġġa fil-baċiri, tkellem lil nies li jkunu qed inaddfu l-jottijiet tagħhom, tipprova tikkuntattja baħrin fil-bar, eċċ.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Ipprova tkellem mal-akbar numru ta' nies possibbli. Wara ftit kulħadd ikun jafek u jagħtik pariri dwar liema dgħajsa qiegħda tfittex għal xi ħadd.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Trid tagħżel b'attenzjoni liema linja tal-ajru f'alleanza se tuża bħala Vjaġġatur Frekwenti.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Għalkemm tista' taħseb li huwa intuwittiv li tingħaqad mal-linja tal-ajru li ttir biha l-iżjed, għandek tkun taf li l-privileġġi offruti ħafna drabi huma differenti u l-punti tal-vjaġġaturi frekwenti jistgħu jkunu aktar ġenerużi mingħand linja tal-ajru differenti fl-istess alleanza.
